# GTA 6 Hacker: The 2022 Rockstar Leak, the Trial and the 2026 Sentence

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/gta-6-hacker/
Updated: 2026-11-25
Status: confirmed

- The GTA 6 hacker is Arion Kurtaj, a member of the Lapsus$ group, who broke into Rockstar in September 2022 at the age of 17 and posted 90 clips of early development footage.
- A jury found in August 2023 that he carried out the hacks, and in December 2023 a judge gave him an indefinite hospital order because he had been ruled unfit to stand trial.
- After a new assessment he pleaded guilty on November 16, 2026 and was sentenced to seven years on November 23, 2026; he was released on licence the same day because of the time already served.

The GTA 6 hacker is Arion Kurtaj, who broke into Rockstar Games in September 2022, when he was 17, and posted 90 clips of early development footage online. He was arrested within days, a jury found in 2023 that he had carried out the hack, and he spent most of the next three years in a secure hospital. The case only closed this week: he pleaded guilty on November 16, 2026, three days before the game launched, and was sentenced on November 23. This page sets out the whole story in order, with dates, and what it did and did not change for the game.
How we checked this: every fact comes from Rockstar and Take-Two's own statements, the Crown Prosecution Service, or court reporting that at least two reputable outlets agree on. We do not describe, host or link to the stolen material.
The GTA 6 hack at a glance

Date
What happened

September 18, 2022
90 clips of early GTA 6 development footage appear on a fan forum

September 19, 2022
Rockstar confirms a "network intrusion"; Take-Two files the same statement with the US regulator

September 22, 2022
City of London Police arrest a 17-year-old in Oxfordshire

November 2022
Take-Two's chief executive says the leak will not influence development

August 2023
A jury at Southwark Crown Court finds he committed the acts on all 12 charges

December 4, 2023
Trailer 1 leaks; Rockstar publishes it about 15 hours early

December 21, 2023
Reports of an indefinite hospital order

January 2026
Moved to prison after being found fit to plead

November 16, 2026
Guilty pleas at Woolwich Crown Court

November 19, 2026
GTA 6 launches

November 23, 2026
Seven-year sentence; released on licence the same day

What happened in September 2022
Early on Sunday, September 18, 2022, a user on the GTAForums fan site posted 90 video clips from an unfinished build of the next Grand Theft Auto. Court reporting later put the total at close to an hour of footage. It was early development material, well over a year before Rockstar showed the game itself.
According to the Crown Prosecution Service (CPS), the poster used the alias "TeaPotUberHacker", had broken into Rockstar with the intention of blackmailing the company, and threatened to release the game's source code as well. Court reports from 2023 add that he announced himself inside Rockstar's internal Slack workspace and demanded contact before the clips went public.
Why it matters: this was a break-in, not a slip by an employee. That distinction is why it ended in a criminal court rather than in an internal investigation, and why it is treated differently from ordinary "leaks" and rumours.
What Rockstar and Take-Two said
Rockstar answered the next day, September 19, 2022. Its statement, which Take-Two also filed with the US Securities and Exchange Commission, said that an unauthorised third party had illegally accessed and downloaded confidential information, including early development footage for the next Grand Theft Auto. It said live services were not disrupted, that work on the game would continue as planned, and that the studio did not expect a long-term effect on its projects. Rockstar added that it was extremely disappointed to have details of the game shared this way.
Take-Two also moved to have the footage removed. Videos disappeared from YouTube at its request, and takedown notices went to GTAForums and the GTA 6 subreddit, which then banned links to the material.
Why it matters: the statement was the first time Rockstar acknowledged any footage of the game at all. Until then it had only said, in February 2022, that development was under way. See how long GTA 6 was in development.
Who leaked GTA 6
The person responsible was Arion Kurtaj, from Oxfordshire, a member of the Lapsus$ cybercrime group. He was 17 at the time, so UK reporting restrictions kept his name out of the early coverage; he was named in reports of the 2023 verdict, by which time he was 18.
Rockstar was not his only target. The CPS lists attacks on BT and EE in 2021, on the fintech company Revolut, and on Uber, where the attack cost more than $2.8 million. The Uber and Rockstar intrusions both took place in September 2022.
The circumstances were unusual. He was already on bail over earlier hacking allegations and had been moved to a hotel for his own protection. The CPS says he broke his bail conditions there and carried on using a mobile phone, the hotel television and a Fire Stick.
Why it matters: the "GTA 6 leaker" was not a Rockstar insider and not a group of developers. The answer to "who leaked GTA 6" is one teenager acting as part of a wider hacking group, which is also why nothing similar followed from inside the studio.
The arrest
City of London Police arrested a 17-year-old in Oxfordshire on September 22, 2022, four days after the clips appeared, in an investigation supported by the National Crime Agency. Police said he was charged with breaching bail and with computer misuse offences and was kept in custody. At the time the force would not say which incident the arrest related to; the link to Rockstar was confirmed in court later.
Why it matters: the speed of the arrest is the reason the threatened follow-up never turned into a long campaign against the studio.
The 2023 trial and the hospital order
The case reached Southwark Crown Court in the summer of 2023 and lasted seven weeks. Before it began, a medical assessment had found him unfit to plead. That changed what the jury was asked: not whether he was guilty in the usual sense, but whether he had done the acts alleged. In August 2023 the jury found that he had, on all 12 charges. A 17-year-old co-defendant, who was not named, was dealt with in the same trial and later received an 18-month youth rehabilitation order.
In December 2023 the judge made a hospital order with no end date: he would stay in a secure hospital until doctors judged he was no longer a danger. According to reports of the hearing, the court heard that he had autism and that he had said he intended to return to cybercrime. We are not adding anything about his health beyond what was said in court.
Why it matters: many headlines called this a "life sentence". It was not a prison sentence at all. A hospital order is reviewed by doctors, and that is exactly what reopened the case two years later.
What the hack cost Rockstar
The figure most often quoted comes from the December 2023 hearing: Rockstar told the court that recovering from the intrusion cost it $5 million, plus thousands of hours of staff time. That is Rockstar's own estimate as reported from court, not an audited number, and it covers the response to the break-in, not lost sales.
Why it matters: set against the scale of the project it is small. Our breakdown of the GTA 6 budget shows why a seven-figure cost was a nuisance and not a threat to the game.
The Trailer 1 leak in December 2023
The same month as the hospital order, GTA 6 leaked again, in a much smaller way. On December 4, 2023, a copy of Trailer 1 appeared on X shortly before its planned debut. Rockstar responded within the hour by publishing the trailer itself, about 15 hours ahead of schedule, and asked people to watch the real thing on YouTube.
No report we have read connects this to the 2022 intrusion or to Kurtaj, who was in custody at the time. The details of each official video are in all GTA 6 trailers.
Tip: when you see "the GTA 6 leak" mentioned, check which one is meant. The 2022 hack, the 2023 trailer and later incidents are separate events.
What happened to the GTA 6 hacker in 2026
A routine assessment in 2025 found him fit to plead, and the CPS reopened the case. He was moved from hospital to prison in January 2026. In March 2026 he was found with a mobile phone in prison, which became one more charge.
On November 16, 2026, at Woolwich Crown Court, he pleaded guilty to three counts of unauthorised acts to impair the operation of a computer, one count of fraud, one count of unauthorised access with intent, and possessing a mobile phone in prison. ITV News also reported two counts of assaulting an emergency worker.
Why it matters: the 2023 jury had only decided that he did the acts. The 2026 pleas are the first convictions in the ordinary sense, which is why the CPS headline that day used the word "convicted".
The GTA 6 hacker sentence
On November 23, 2026, four days after launch, Mr Justice Turner sentenced him to seven years. He left court the same day, released on licence, because the time he had already spent in hospital and prison covered most of the term. Reports of the hearing say the judge called him a very talented young man and told him not to let it happen again.
Release came with conditions. A five-year Serious Crime Prevention Order restricts his use of online services, including Telegram and Discord.
Why it matters: "released" does not mean "cleared". He is a convicted offender serving the rest of a seven-year sentence in the community, under an order that can send him back to court if he breaks it.
Did the hack change GTA 6?
Not in any way Rockstar or Take-Two has acknowledged.

Development. In November 2022, Take-Two chief executive Strauss Zelnick told investors the leak would not influence development and that there was no evidence significant assets had been taken.
The schedule. Trailer 1 arrived in December 2023 with a 2025 window. The two later delays, to May 26, 2026 and then to November 19, 2026, were explained by the need for more polish. Rockstar never cited the hack. Full history: GTA 6 delays and the release date guide.
The game. The footage was from an early build. What shipped is covered in GTA 6 gameplay.
Security. Zelnick said the incident made the company more watchful about cybersecurity. Rockstar has not published details of what it changed.

Why it matters: the most visible effect was on fans, not on the game. Community projects such as the GTA 6 mapping project had to write rules about what material they would accept.
Later breaches that were not the same hacker
Two 2026 incidents are often mixed up with this case.
In April 2026, the ShinyHunters group claimed to have data taken from Rockstar through a third-party analytics provider. Rockstar confirmed that a limited amount of non-material company information had been accessed and said there was no impact on the company or its players.
Later in 2026, an anonymous party using the name "Cyberleek" published footage ahead of launch. That is a separate matter from the 2022 case, and we do not cover its contents here.
What is not confirmed

How much was taken beyond the clips. Source code was threatened, and outlets differ on what else left the building. Take-Two's public position was that there was no evidence of significant assets being stolen.
Whether any ransom was paid. Reports say Rockstar did not engage. Rockstar has not commented.
What Rockstar changed internally. No official account exists.
How Trailer 1 got out early. Rockstar has never said.
The exact licence terms beyond the Serious Crime Prevention Order reported from court.

How to tell real GTA 6 news from fake leaks
Now that the game is out, "leaks" have turned into bait: fake PC builds, fake online betas and fake DLC.

Check Rockstar first. New content is announced on the Rockstar Newswire and its official accounts. Our GTA 6 news round-up and update tracker follow those.
Never download a "leaked build". GTA 6 is not on PC yet, so any PC download is fake at best. See GTA 6 on PC.
Ignore sign-up pages for GTA 6 Online access. No online mode has been dated. See GTA 6 online.
Turn on two-step verification for your Rockstar account, and for the PlayStation or Xbox account it is linked to.
Use a unique password, and never type it into a page you reached from a video description or a direct message.
Do not share stolen footage. Take-Two has had it removed since 2022, and forums ban it.

What this means for you
The story of the GTA 6 hacker is finished as a court case and never mattered much as a game story. It cost Rockstar money and spoiled the first look at the game, but it did not move the release date by any account the company has given, and nothing from 2022 tells you anything useful about the game you can play today.
What we will add to this page
We will update this page if the court publishes its sentencing remarks, if Rockstar or Take-Two say more about the cost or the security changes, or if there is any appeal or further hearing. If later incidents lead to charges, we will cover them separately and link them from here.

Q: What happened to the GTA 6 hacker?
A: Arion Kurtaj was given an indefinite hospital order in December 2023. After he was later found fit to plead, he admitted the offences on November 16, 2026 and was sentenced to seven years at Woolwich Crown Court on November 23, 2026. He was released on licence that day because of the time he had already spent in custody.

Q: Who leaked GTA 6?
A: The September 2022 GTA 6 leak was the work of Arion Kurtaj, then 17, a member of the Lapsus$ hacking group, according to the Crown Prosecution Service. He posted 90 clips of early development footage under an alias after breaking into Rockstar's systems.

Q: Did the GTA 6 leak delay the game?
A: Rockstar and Take-Two said it would not. Rockstar's statement in September 2022 said work would continue as planned, and Take-Two's chief executive told investors in November 2022 that the leak would not influence development. Rockstar never gave the hack as a reason for either later delay.

# GTA 6 Police and Gangs: Every Force, Every Crew, Where They Are

URL: https://gta6box.com/characters/gta-6-police-and-gangs/
Updated: 2026-11-25
Status: partly

- Leonida has no single police force: city departments, county sheriffs, a highway patrol and state agencies each carry their own name and livery.
- Eight named gangs plus a group of independent criminals run 39 illegal operations across the map.
- Police no longer show on the minimap; you find them with Focus, and they keep a description of you after the chase.

GTA 6 police are not one force but a patchwork of city departments, county sheriffs and state agencies, and the criminal side is just as split: eight named gangs hold their own corners of Leonida. This page covers who they all are, how the cops behave, where each gang operates and how both affect missions and free roam.
It does not repeat how stars and heat work; that is in our GTA 6 wanted level guide. Everything below is confirmed by Rockstar or by at least two guides that agree, and single-source details are named as such.

Why it matters: the force you meet changes with the region, but no guide reports that one agency chases differently from another.
How GTA 6 cops respond

They have to be called. GTABase lists three triggers: a witness, a robbery alarm, or a stolen vehicle with an advanced tracker. Officers then travel to the scene rather than appearing next to you.
They are not on the minimap. Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told press that police "show up when you use Focus" instead of on the radar.
They remember. Nelson said the team wanted police to have "a bit more persistent memory", so a description of you outlasts the chase.
Weapons in the open draw attention. Carrying a visible gun gets a reaction from cops and civilians before you fire.
Helicopters and K-9 units join in. A police helicopter is overhead from the start of the escape in Bricked Up. K-9 units were shown in Edge magazine's hands-on, and GTABase says a dog keeps tracking you once it is called in.
Violence changes the response. GTABase says killing officers makes the pursuit more aggressive and moves your Criminal Profile toward Violent. Shooting out tyres slows a chase without that cost.

Two details come from one source each. Edge's hands-on, as reported by Beebom, describes spike strips that are hard to see at night. GTABase says a helicopter can pull back if you shoot at it.
Tip: tap Focus before you leave a building during a chase. It is the only reliable way to see where officers are.
Getting arrested
You can surrender at lower wanted levels. Guides agree on two costs of an arrest:

You lose cash.
You lose weapons you picked up; weapons you own are kept.

Guides disagree on how much cash goes and where you wake up, so we do not state either. A car left in the search area can be impounded; the Impounded Vehicle walkthrough shows how to get one back.
Police in story missions
The police are also characters. In Bricked Up, a pickup for Boobie Ike is raided by Captain Méndez and his dirty cops. In The Cartel Heist, cutting cell towers buys time before police arrive, and a SWAT team then breaches the bank. Mission chases are scripted, so the star level you face there is fixed.
GTA 6 gangs: all eight and where they operate
The Progress menu has a Gangs tab that tracks each group's illegal operations. PowerPyx and KeenGamer give the same counts:

Why it matters: the map splits cleanly. Rural Leonida belongs to the Kingfishers, Kolts and Final Chapter; Vice City is shared by San4San, PTT Youngin$ and the Guardia Brothers.
How gangs affect missions
Most gangs are introduced by the story before you can rob them:

Gang
Where you meet them

Kingfishers
Gone Fishing, where they take Donnie

Cash City, the crew that protects DWNPLY in Ride or Die, is a gang in the story but has no operations of its own in the Progress menu.
How gangs affect free roam
Gang turf matters in free roam through illegal operations: guarded sites with a safe, valuables and often narcotics.

An operation stays hidden until you enter its area. Before that, the map calls it a "Robbery Opportunity".
Clearing the guards is not enough. You must collect every key valuable for it to count.
A finished operation turns grey, then comes back after a cooldown and can be robbed again.
One operation from each of the nine groups earns the Pest Control trophy; all 39 are needed for 100% completion.

KeenGamer reports that police are slower to react at gang sites than at stores or banks, and that a suppressed weapon keeps a raid quiet. No second guide confirms this yet.
Tip: rob one site per gang as the story takes you through each region. It is the cheapest route to Pest Control, and the wider robbery system is covered in GTA 6 heists.
What is not confirmed

Gang wars or territory control. No guide describes taking over turf.
Gangs attacking you on sight in their area during free roam. Only mission-specific chases are documented.
Different tactics per agency, and which units arrive at which star level.
A military response at six stars. This comes from leaks, not from the game.
A Kelly County Police Department. It was named by fans from the first trailer, but we have not found it confirmed in the released game.
Arrest details: the exact cash penalty and the respawn point.
Bribes, or paying to clear a wanted level.

We will add the per-star police response and a list of all 39 operation sites once two guides agree on them.

Q: How do GTA 6 police work?
A: Officers are sent to a crime when a witness, an alarm or a vehicle tracker reports it. They do not appear on the minimap, they remember your face, clothes and vehicle, and at higher levels helicopters and K-9 units join in.

Q: How many GTA 6 gangs are there?
A: Eight named gangs: Kingfishers, Kolts & Associates, M7, La Polilla Negra, Final Chapter, San4San, PTT Youngin$ and the Guardia Brothers. The game's Progress menu adds a ninth group, Other Criminals.

Q: Can you surrender to GTA 6 cops?
A: Yes, at lower wanted levels. Being arrested costs you cash and any weapons you picked up rather than bought; weapons you own are kept.

Q: Are there gang wars or territory takeovers in GTA 6?
A: No guide we have checked describes a turf war system. Gang locations are robbed as illegal operations, which come back after a cooldown instead of changing hands.

# GTA 6 Power Play Walkthrough: Heist Plans and Armored Truck

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-power-play-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-25
Status: confirmed

- Power Play is a Chapter 4 mission from Kordell that Lucia starts at the crew's base in Salton after Child's Play; it pays $40,000.
- You play both leads: Jason sneaks into the base and photographs the back of the whiteboard, then Lucia covers the crew during an armored truck robbery.
- The optional mission Bad Driver! is gone for good once Power Play begins, so finish it first.

This GTA 6 Power Play walkthrough covers the mission where Lucia rides along on a job with Kordell's crew while Jason breaks into their base to find out what they are really planning. It has three very different parts: a quiet break-in, a street shootout around an armored truck, and a long escape on foot and by car. The third part is where most of the danger is.
Read this first: Bad Driver! closes here
The optional mission Bad Driver! is missable, and Power Play is the cut-off. PowerPyx's page for that mission says it becomes permanently unavailable after Power Play and should be finished before it. If you still want to deal with Felipe, do that now.
PowerPyx's mission list also places a time-sensitive optional Lucia mission, This is a Free Call From…, just before Power Play. Time-sensitive missions show an hourglass icon on the map, so check for one before you head to Salton.

Step-by-step
1. Meet Kordell (Lucia)
Take Lucia to the crew's base in Salton and talk to the receptionist. You are sent down the hall to the room where Kordell and the crew are. After the scene, control passes to Jason.
2. Get into the building (Jason)
Jason sneaks in over the roof.

Go to the right side of the building and climb the ladder.
Cross the roof to the far side.
Drop down to the lower level there.
Go in through the open door.

3. Reach the planning room
Head down to the ground floor. The planning room is behind the door on the right. Both guides open it with the Snap Gun, the lock tool you get from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
4. Photograph the heist plans

What to photograph
Does it count?

Front of the whiteboard
Not enough on its own

Back of the whiteboard
Yes: this side has the real plans

Shirts, bags and other items in the room
Optional; GTABase says they do not matter for progress

Interact with the whiteboard to flip it over, then take the picture of the reverse side. It is easy to get stuck here, because the room has several things you can photograph and only the back of the board moves the mission on.
5. Block the road (Lucia)
Back with Lucia, take the cones from the truck and set them in a line across the road so traffic stops. Then follow Kordell.
6. Cover the crew
Kordell knocks over a box at the side of the road. Take the assault rifle from it. The crew goes to work on the armored truck, and police arrive from every side of the junction. Your job is to keep them off the crew until the truck is emptied.
Tip: do not fix on one street. Both guides warn that officers come from all directions, so keep turning and check behind you between targets.
7. Escape through the construction site
When the crew is done, follow Kordell under the highway and into the construction site.

Work up through the floors. The sides of the building are open, so watch them for police.
Clear the rooftop and the balcony.
Go up one more floor and jump across to the highway.
Move along the highway between the crashed cars. Expect enemies ahead and on the right.

8. Steal a car and lose the cops
Kordell and Nate tell you to grab a car.

Car
Take it?

The car facing you
No: that way is blocked

The small car at the far end, pointing down the road
Yes

Run to the end of the area, take the small car and concentrate on driving. Take the first right on the highway to get around the roadblock, then keep going until the police lose you. Our wanted level guide has more on shaking a chase.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists a formal fail condition. The trouble spots they point to are these:

The whiteboard. Photographing only the front, or only the other items, does not finish the objective.
The junction. Police come from all sides while the crew is at the truck.
The construction site. The open floors let officers shoot in from outside.
The getaway car. Taking the car that faces you sends you toward a blocked route, and missing the first right leads to the roadblock.

100%

Power Play gives Jason and Lucia the crew's real plans, which feeds the rest of the airport job outlined in GTA 6 heists. PowerPyx lists the Jason-only mission Close Surveillance next. The story before this point is covered in Fresh Evidence and Child's Play, and the full order is in our GTA 6 mission list.

Q: Where are the heist plans in the GTA 6 Power Play walkthrough?
A: In the planning room on the ground floor of Kordell's base, behind the door on the right. Photograph the whiteboard, then turn it over and photograph the back: the real plans are on the reverse side.

Q: How do you start Power Play in GTA 6?
A: Finish Child's Play, then take Lucia to Kordell's crew base in Salton, Vice City, and ask the receptionist about Kordell.

Q: What is the reward for Power Play?
A: $40,000. Both PowerPyx and GTABase list the same payout.

Q: What should you do before starting Power Play?
A: Play the optional mission Bad Driver! if you want it. PowerPyx says it becomes permanently unavailable once Power Play starts. A manual save is also worth making, because missions cannot be replayed.

# GTA 6 Too Much Baggage Walkthrough: Scope Out the Airport

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-too-much-baggage-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-25
Status: confirmed

- Too Much Baggage is a Jason-only Chapter 4 mission given by Andrea that starts at Vice City International Airport after Making Gainz.
- Jason works a shift as a baggage handler under Omar while scanning points of interest for Karim through camera glasses.
- The goal is to plant a device behind the toilet in the security office restroom, then tell Omar you want the job.

This GTA 6 Too Much Baggage walkthrough covers Jason's undercover shift as a baggage handler at Vice City International Airport. There is no shooting and no chase. The mission is a string of small tasks, and the two that slow players down are the bag-throwing power bar and finding the right door to the security office.
Before you start

Detail

The mission is part of the setup for the airport job. At the end of Making Gainz, Raul decides that Jason will be the one to scope out the airport, while Lucia keeps working on Kordell's crew at the gym. Because Making Gainz starts the stretch where the couple cannot be seen together in public, this is a solo trip.
Objectives
PowerPyx lists thirteen on-screen steps.

Enter the parking lot.
Go to the office.
Follow Omar.
Get in the baggage tug.
Attach the trailers to the baggage tug.
Go to the plane.
Pick up the bag.
Go to the loading bay.
Go to the security office.
Enter the restroom.
Plant the device.

Step-by-step
1. Get into the airport
Drive Jason to VCIA and stop at the gate to speak to the guard. Drive into the parking lot, park, and walk to the nearby office to meet Andrea. Output Lag adds that the entrance is the north gate and that Jason tells security he is there for orientation.
2. Scan the crates on the ride with Omar
Omar, the head baggage handler, drives Jason into the airport. Jason is wearing glasses that feed what he sees to Karim. During the ride the view is first person, and the glasses highlight white crates around you.
Look at each highlighted crate and hold your view on it until the highlight turns green. Each one is a point of interest for Karim. If the camera feels awkward here, our guide to first-person mode explains the view controls.
3. Hitch the baggage tug
When Omar stops, follow him on foot. He leads you to the baggage carts. Get in the baggage tug next to them and reverse it into the two trailers to attach them.
Tip: Output Lag's advice is to line the tug up straight with the first trailer and back up slowly. If you come in at an angle and it does not connect, pull forward, straighten and try again.
4. Drive to the plane and load the bags
Drive the tug to the plane that is being unloaded in the southern part of the airport. Here Jason throws bags to Omar, who stacks them on the trailer.

Step
What to do

Pick up
Take a bag when prompted

Charge
Hold the throw button to fill the power bar (PowerPyx gives R2 on PlayStation, RT on Xbox)

Release
Let go a little before the bar reaches the middle zone

Repeat
Keep going until every bag is loaded

The reason for releasing early is that the bar keeps rising for a moment after you let go. Both PowerPyx and GTABase make the same point: aim short of the target zone and the overshoot carries it in.
5. Slip away to the security office
Once the bags are done, Jason makes an excuse to leave Omar. This is the part with the most room for getting lost, so take it one turn at a time:

Leave the loading bay.
Follow the wall south to the last double doors on the left and go in.
Inside, keep to the left wall until you reach the hallway.
Go through the blue office door. This is the security office.
The restroom is immediately on your right. Go in.

6. Plant the device
Interact with the spot behind the toilet to place the device. Output Lag describes it as a Wi-Fi cloner that lets Karim pull data from the security system nearby; PowerPyx and GTABase simply call it a bug or device.
7. Return to Omar and take the job
Leave the restroom and you are taken back to Omar. When he talks to you, focus on him (PowerPyx gives L2 or LT) and tell him you want the job. That ends the mission.
Where players fail
None of the three guides lists a fail condition. The trouble spots are practical:

Bags falling short or flying long. Release before the middle of the bar, not on it.
Missing a crate on the ride. Keep looking at a highlighted crate until it turns green before moving to the next.
Wrong door. It is the last set of double doors on the left as you follow the wall south from the bay, then the blue door inside.
Trailers not attaching. Reverse straight and slowly.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Cash
None listed (PowerPyx)

Unlocks
Progress on the VCIA Takedown setup

100%
GTABase marks the mission as required

No guide lists an optional objective for this mission. Missions cannot be replayed, so if you want a restore point before it, see how to save in GTA 6.
What comes next
Both PowerPyx and GTABase place Jason's next mission as Watch It, a job with Dre'Quan in Vice Beach that also needs only Making Gainz. PowerPyx notes that missions can show up in a slightly different order in the game, so do whichever marker appears first. The airport comes back much later in the chapter; GTA 6 heists outlines the whole chain, and the full order is in our GTA 6 mission list.

Q: Where do you plant the device in the GTA 6 Too Much Baggage walkthrough?
A: Behind the toilet in the restroom of the security office. Leave the loading bay, follow the wall south to the last double doors on the left, keep to the left wall into the hallway and go through the blue office door. The restroom is on your right.

Q: How do you throw the bags in Too Much Baggage?
A: Hold the throw button to fill the power bar and let go just before it reaches the middle zone. The bar keeps moving for a moment after you release, so releasing early lands it in the right place.

Q: How do you start Too Much Baggage in GTA 6?
A: Finish Making Gainz, then take Jason to Vice City International Airport. Talk to the guard, park in the lot and walk to the nearby office to meet Andrea.

Q: Is there a reward for Too Much Baggage?
A: PowerPyx lists no reward. The mission is a setup step for the VCIA Takedown, and GTABase marks it as required for 100% completion.

# GTA 6 Watch It Walkthrough: Crowex Dealer, Nola and Royce Jones

- Watch It is a Jason-only Chapter 4 mission from Dre'Quan that starts at a store in Washington Beach after Making Gainz.

- The outfit choice at Nola is free and has no listed consequence; the mission ends at the Doight d'Or hotel with Royce Jones.

This GTA 6 Watch It walkthrough covers Jason's errand with Dre'Quan that begins with a complaint about a watch and ends in a meeting with a nightclub owner. Most of it is driving and following. The one part that can go wrong is the parking lot, where a fist fight becomes a gunfight with very little warning.

Go into the marked store as Jason and head upstairs. Dre'Quan is talking to the clerk; wait for him to finish. Output Lag describes the place as a jewelry store where Dre'Quan has just been told that his watch is not what he paid for, which fits what happens next.
Follow him back outside and get in your car.
2. Drive to the Cruda parking lot
Drive south to the marked parking lot. The men who sold Dre'Quan the watch are waiting there. Go in through the entrance and take the ramps all the way to the top floor, then park next to the marked car.
3. The Crowex dealer: fist fight, then gunfight
Dre'Quan walks over to talk to the men in the car. Stay close. The talk goes badly, they get out, and a fight starts.

When the last enemy is down, get back in your car and leave. Both PowerPyx and GTABase say to go before the police arrive, so do not stop to look around. Output Lag's version has the police already on the scene at this point and recommends leaving by the stairs, not the ramp; we could not confirm that against the other two guides. If you do pick up attention, how the wanted level works covers losing it.

Choose either one. Dre'Quan pays.
He takes the one you leave.

Neither PowerPyx nor GTABase lists any difference between the two beyond the look, so pick the one you prefer. For changing back later, see how to change clothes and hair.
6. Meet Royce Jones at the Doight d'Or
Drive north to the Doight d'Or hotel. Follow Dre'Quan through the building and out the back, where he meets Royce Jones. GTABase identifies Royce as the owner of the VYB nightclub. The mission ends when their conversation does.
Output Lag adds that Dre'Quan is asking for a headline slot for the Dimez and that Royce wants a favor first. We have that from one guide only, so we will fill in the story details when a second source matches.
Where players fail
No guide lists a formal fail condition. In practice there are two ways to lose time:

Dying on the roof. The gunmen fire the moment they arrive and a second group comes from the stairs. Do not stand in the open after the fist fight, and keep an eye on the stairwell.
Staying too long afterward. Leave as soon as the area is clear so the police do not become a second fight.

Missions cannot be replayed once finished. If you want a manual restore point first, see how to save in GTA 6.

PowerPyx and GTABase agree that Watch It follows Too Much Baggage, and both missions need only Making Gainz, so the game may offer them in either order. Q: Which outfit should you pick in the GTA 6 Watch It walkthrough?
A: Either one. Dre'Quan pays for the outfit you choose from the two mannequins at Nola and takes the other himself. Neither PowerPyx nor GTABase lists any effect on the story.

Q: How do you start Watch It in GTA 6?
A: Finish Making Gainz, then take Jason to the marked store in Washington Beach, Vice Beach. Go upstairs and wait for Dre'Quan to finish talking to the clerk.

Q: Where is the Crowex dealer in Watch It?

A: PowerPyx lists no reward. Dre'Quan pays for the outfit you pick at Nola, and GTABase marks the mission as required for 100% completion.

# Will Franklin Be in GTA 6? Every Returning Character and Cameo

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/will-franklin-be-in-gta-6/
Updated: 2026-11-25
Status: partly

- Franklin, Michael and Trevor are not reported in person in GTA 6; the launch coverage we checked finds them only as references, mainly in a true-crime podcast.
- Three familiar faces from earlier games do turn up in the story, two of them as short cameos in Chapters 4 and 5.
- Tommy Vercetti is a name and a set of Vice City nods, and no launch guide we read reports Lester at all.

Will Franklin be in GTA 6? Not in person: one week after launch, no reputable guide reports Franklin Clinton on screen, and he exists in the game only as a reference. The same is true of Michael and Trevor. A few characters from older games really do appear, though, and one of them is a much bigger surprise than any GTA 5 lead. Below is a character-by-character verdict, where each reference is, and what is still open.
A character is marked "yes" here only when at least two independent outlets describe the same appearance. Everything else is listed as a reference or as unconfirmed. Mild spoilers follow for Chapters 4 and 5: we name who appears and in which mission, but not how the story ends.
Returning characters at a glance

Is Franklin in GTA 6?
No launch guide we read places Franklin in a mission, a cutscene or the open world. Game Rant's list of returning characters, published on November 20, has three names, and Franklin is not one of them. What the game does have is a true-crime podcast that revisits the Los Santos crimes of GTA 5, and GamesRadar+ reports that its hosts talk about three dangerous criminals connected to a string of bank robberies. That is Franklin, Michael and Trevor, discussed as a cold case.
The question has a long history. On November 14, 2023, GamesRadar+ reported that Franklin's actor, Shawn Fonteno, posted and quickly deleted a cryptic GTA 6 tease. The same article notes that he had earlier said Franklin would not be in the game, then called it a mystery. Nothing in the released game backs up the tease.
Why it matters: if you were holding off for a Franklin mission, there is none to wait for. The story belongs to Jason and Lucia; see the full cast in GTA 6 characters.
Is Michael in GTA 6?
Michael De Santa is the most referenced of the three, but he is not seen either. Besides the podcast, two nods point straight at him:

The yacht. A Marquis is moored outside Jason's house in the Keys. KeenGamer ties it to the boat Jimmy sells behind his father's back in GTA 5, and the lists we used for our own GTA 6 easter eggs page add that its navigation screen shows Los Santos.
The ringtone. "Wind Chimes", Michael's ringtone in GTA 5, is in the phone settings.

Tip: the yacht is the easiest GTA 5 reference to see for yourself, because it sits next to your first safehouse. Walk down to the water before you leave the Keys for good.
Will Trevor be in GTA 6?
Trevor Philips is never on screen, and the podcast comes closest to him. Its subject is Wade Hebert, Trevor's hanger-on from GTA 5, and the deaths of Wade's cousin Floyd and Floyd's fiancée Debra. Rolling Stone Brasil reports that the show has Wade arrested at a strip club and sentenced in 2014 to 50 years for the two killings, with the host doubting he did it. GamesRadar+ adds that the hosts question how much Wade really knew about his friend. GTA 5 players know who was in that apartment.
Steven Ogg, who played Trevor, was asked about GTA 6 on Michael Rosenbaum's podcast, and GamesRadar+ covered it on February 5, 2025. He denied hating the character and said he would not be playing the new game. That is a comment about playing it, not about Trevor's role in it.
Why it matters: the podcast picks up a thread GTA 5 left hanging, what became of Wade, so it is worth hearing even if you only care about the old cast. Podcasts sit alongside the GTA 6 radio stations.
Will Lester be in GTA 6?
No guide we checked reports Lester Crest in GTA 6, as a character or as a reference. Two pre-launch theories explain why people keep asking:

The Cal Hampton theory. Fans thought Jason's conspiracy-minded friend Cal sounded like Lester's actor, Jay Klaitz. TechRadar reported on April 14, 2026 that Klaitz denied voicing Cal in an interview with the marketplace Eldorado.
The retirement theory. In GTA Online's Agents of Sabotage update, Lester sells the player his garment factory and says he has retired. Dexerto reported on December 11, 2024 that fans read this as Rockstar clearing him for GTA 6.

Neither theory has been borne out so far. We list Lester as "not reported" and not as a firm "no" because a week is a short time for a game this size.
Tip: if a video claims a Lester call or email, check whether it shows the mission name and chapter. None of the published walkthroughs has one.
Is Tommy Vercetti in GTA 6?
Tommy Vercetti is in GTA 6 as a name, not as a person. The clearest reference is in Rockstar's own edition text: the Ultimate Edition includes revolvers with Vice City styling that are said to come from the Vercetti Estate. That puts his mansion, at least by name, in this version of Vice City. See what else is in the Ultimate Edition.
KeenGamer lists three more nods: the palm-tree weapon pattern in the Vintage Vice City Pack, which echoes Tommy's shirt; the Ocean View Hotel in Ocean Beach, his first safehouse in 2002; and a trophy called "In The Beginning…", earned in Ocean Beach.
Why it matters: a walking, talking Tommy was always unlikely. Ray Liotta, who voiced him, died in 2022, and the 2002 game sits in an older continuity than GTA 4, GTA 5 and GTA 6. A name on a gun case lets Rockstar honor him without recasting him.
Jimmy De Santa: the one GTA 5 character you meet
Michael's son Jimmy is the only GTA 5 character reported in person. Game Rant places him in the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners, where Jason and Lucia work security at a club and you decide whether Jimmy gets in. He does not come back afterwards. Danny Tamberelli, who played him in GTA 5, returns for the role.
Tip: Headliners is part of the long setup for the Chapter 4 airport job, so you cannot miss it, but the choice at the door is quick. Make a manual save first if you want to see both outcomes; here is how to save in GTA 6.
Niko Bellic: the GTA 4 lead returns
The biggest returning name is Niko Bellic, the protagonist of GTA 4. Game Rant, KeenGamer and esports.gg all place him in the Chapter 5 main mission Taking Liberties, and KeenGamer and SoapCentral count two cutscenes. He is older, he is not playable, and he has business with a shipping heir, Giorgio Gallo, that crosses Jason and Lucia's path.
Rockstar kept it quiet in the credits. Michael Hollick, Niko's original actor, is listed as "The Hitman", and SoapCentral noted on November 20 that Rockstar had not commented on the role.
Why it matters: GTA 5 mentioned Niko without ever showing him, so this is his first appearance on screen since 2008, and it ties Liberty City directly to Leonida. If you want to reach it quickly, see how many chapters GTA 6 has.
Valentina: from GTA Online to the main story
Valentina first appeared in GTA Online's Money Fronts update in 2025 as a client of Mr. Faber. Game Rant counts her as a returning character and names Josephine Phoenix as her actor. In GTA 6 she is a Chapter 4 contact who houses Jason and Lucia at the Y Hotel and hands out work.
Tip: her first scene is in our Ocean Beach walkthrough, and the rest of her jobs are in the GTA 6 mission list.
What is not confirmed

The podcast's name. GamesRadar+ calls it Vice City True Stories; Rolling Stone Brasil calls it Final Act and says five podcasts ship with the game. We have not been able to settle which is right.
How the trio are named on air. GamesRadar+ describes allusions; fan sites say Michael and Franklin are named and Trevor is not. We could not confirm the exact wording from two reputable outlets.
The cast list. Fan sites report that Shawn Fonteno, Ned Luke and Steven Ogg are absent from Rockstar's credits. We could not open the credits page ourselves, so treat that as likely, not proven.
A post-launch statement from Steven Ogg. Several fan sites say he has confirmed Trevor is not in the game, without a date or a link. The only dated comment we found is the 2025 one above.
Phil Cassidy. A gun-store owner resembles him and the Phil's Ammu-Nation name is back, but Beebom treats it as a lookalike, and no credit ties him to the Vice City character.
Whether Valentina is officially the same woman. Outlets treat her as such; Rockstar has not said so.
Lester and Lamar. No reports so far, which is not the same as proof they are absent.

How to find the references yourself

Visit the yacht first. At Jason's house in the Keys, walk to the water and look for the moored Marquis.
Open the phone settings and scroll the ringtones for "Wind Chimes".
Drive in free roam with a podcast on. GamesRadar+ and KeenGamer both heard the Wade episode on a vehicle radio outside missions.
Walk Ocean Beach on foot once the story moves to Vice City, and look for the Ocean View Hotel's pink neon sign. Our Vice City guide covers the district.
Keep a save before Headliners in Chapter 4 and before Taking Liberties in Chapter 5, so you can rewatch the two cameos.
Check the Liberty City and Los Santos cards in the card sets. KeenGamer found a Los Santos Panic card in the Keys; see GTA 6 collectibles.

Verdict: who is really back
GTA 6 does not bring back Franklin, Michael or Trevor as characters. It treats them as local legend: something a podcast host argues about, a boat that ended up in the wrong harbor, a ringtone. The people who actually walk into a scene are a step removed, a son, a client from GTA Online, and one man from Liberty City nobody expected. If you are choosing whether to play for the old cast, play for Jason and Lucia instead, and enjoy the nods as you find them.
What we will add to this page
We will update the table when the credits are confirmed by a second reputable outlet, when the podcast's name and episode order are settled, and if players find Lester, Lamar or any other familiar face. If Rockstar or one of the GTA 5 actors makes a dated, on-the-record statement about the game, it will go in the section for that character.

Q: Will Franklin be in GTA 6?
A: Not in person, as far as launch coverage shows. Franklin is referenced in an in-game true-crime podcast about GTA 5's Los Santos crimes, but no reputable guide reports him on screen, and Rockstar has not announced a role for him.

Q: Is Michael in GTA 6?
A: Michael De Santa is referenced, not seen. The podcast alludes to him, a Marquis yacht near Jason's house recalls his stolen boat, and his son Jimmy De Santa has a short cameo in the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.

Q: Is Tommy Vercetti in GTA 6?
A: Only as a reference. The Ultimate Edition revolvers are described as coming from the Vercetti Estate and the Ocean View Hotel stands in Ocean Beach, but Tommy himself does not appear in any launch guide we checked.

# Can You Make Real Money in GTA 6? What Is True and What Is Not

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/can-you-make-real-money-in-gta-6/
Updated: 2026-11-24
Status: confirmed

- You cannot make real money in GTA 6: it launched as a single-player game, and its in-game dollars cannot be withdrawn, traded or sold.
- Rockstar North's co-studio head is reported to have said the single-player game has no microtransactions; nothing has been announced for a future online mode.
- Claims about crypto rewards, a cash-out currency or paid role-play jobs are rumors or third-party pitches, not Rockstar features.

No, you cannot make real money in GTA 6: the dollars Jason and Lucia earn exist only inside your save file, and the game has no way to withdraw, trade or sell them. The question keeps coming up because of three things that got mixed together before launch: an old insider tweet about crypto, an unverified leak about a tradable currency, and a streamer's promise of paid jobs on a role-play server. This page separates what Rockstar has actually said from what is rumor, shows where each claim came from, and lists the ways people do earn money around the game, none of which involve cashing out in-game cash.
Every statement below is taken from Rockstar or from reporting by at least two outlets; where something rests on a single report or on a leak, we say so.
Real money and GTA 6 at a glance

Question
Answer
Status

Can in-game cash be turned into real money?
No
No such feature in the released game

Can you buy in-game cash in story mode?
Reported as no
Rockstar North's co-studio head, as relayed by Kinda Funny

1. In-game money stays in the game
GTA 6 has a deeper economy than GTA 5. You carry cash that can be lost, bank it through the BuckMe app, sell stolen cars and jewelry, and rob stores and vaults. All of it is play money. It buys weapons, clothes, vehicles and upgrades inside your save, and that is where it ends.
Why it matters: if a video, site or message says a balance in GTA 6 can be "withdrawn", it is describing something the game does not have. For what the money is good for, and the fastest legitimate ways to earn it, see how to make money in GTA 6.
2. GTA 6 launched without an online mode
Real-money trading in games nearly always happens around online economies, where players can pass items or currency to each other. GTA 6 has nothing like that yet. Rockstar describes the launch game as a single-player experience, and it has not announced a name, a date or features for an online mode.
Why it matters: with no multiplayer, there is nobody to trade with and nothing to sell. Our GTA 6 online page tracks what has and has not been announced.
3. What Rockstar has said about microtransactions
The clearest statement came second-hand. Andy Cortez and Greg Miller of Kinda Funny said that during a gameplay preview they asked Rob Nelson, co-studio head at Rockstar North, whether real money could buy anything in the game, and that the answer was no. GamesRadar+ reported this on August 28, 2026, and Beebom repeated it on November 16.
Two caveats:

The statement is relayed by the people who asked, not published by Rockstar.
It covers the single-player game. Both outlets note that Rockstar has stayed silent on how a GTA 6 online mode would be monetized.

Tip: the extras in the $99.99 Ultimate Edition are part of that edition or its upgrade, not items in a cash shop. What each edition includes is in GTA 6 price and editions and the Ultimate Edition guide.
4. Why the age rating mentions in-game purchases
The ESRB entry for GTA 6 carries an "in-game purchases" notice alongside its content descriptors, and some players took that as proof of a store. Beebom's reading is that the notice does not tie the single-player game to microtransactions. Ratings boards apply it to any game that offers digital goods for real money, which can include edition upgrades.
Why it matters: the label tells you money can be spent on the product, not that money can be earned from it. See the GTA 6 age rating for the full list of descriptors.
5. GTA+ gives perks, not income
Rockstar's subscription has benefits in GTA 6. As reported by Engadget and TweakTown, they include discounts in in-game stores, boosts to in-game earnings and free bike rentals. Digital pre-orders came with one month included.
Why it matters: an "earnings boost" raises the play money you receive in the game. It does not pay you. More on what members did and did not get at launch is in GTA 6 early access.
6. Where the crypto rumor came from
Sportskeeda traced this one in a fact check. On June 3, 2021, insider Tom Henderson tweeted that GTA 6 missions might sometimes pay in an in-game cryptocurrency and that a stock-market-style broker would return. Asked whether he meant real crypto, he compared it to the stock market in GTA 5, which is fictional, and told readers to take the claim with a grain of salt.
Over time, "in-game bitcoin" was retold as "GTA 6 will pay you in bitcoin". The original claim never said that.
Why it matters: even taken at face value, the 2021 tweet described a fictional currency inside the story, like GTA 5's BAWSAQ shares. We have not seen two guides confirm a crypto market in the released game, so we do not describe one.
7. The "tradable currency" leak
On August 19, 2026, Gfinity reported a claim from a leaker that GTA 6 would have a currency that could be exchanged for real money, in the style of creator currencies on other platforms. Gfinity labeled the claim unverified, the leaker gave no details of how it would work, and Rockstar neither confirmed nor denied it.
Nothing matching it is in the released game. The idea is usually linked to Rockstar's 2023 purchase of Cfx.re, the team behind the FiveM role-play platform for GTA 5, and to reports of creator tools. Those are plans for community content on PC at most, and Rockstar has announced no payout system for GTA 6.
8. Role-play servers and "quit your job" claims
In May 2026, streamer Adin Ross told viewers that players on a GTA 6 role-play server he is involved with could earn a full-time income from in-game jobs. GTA BOOM's analysis made the key points:

The server is a third-party project, not a Rockstar product.
Any money would come from the server's own economy, sponsors and viewers, not from Rockstar or Take-Two.
GTA 6 is on consoles only, so role-play servers of the GTA 5 kind have nowhere to run yet.
People who earned from GTA 5 role-play did it by drawing an audience, not from wages paid inside a server.

Tip: treat any offer of a paid "job" in GTA 6 as marketing until there is a PC version, an official platform and written terms. The PC situation is covered in GTA 6 on PC.
9. How people really earn money around GTA 6
These are the routes that exist today. None converts in-game dollars.

Route
Where the money comes from
What it takes

Streaming and video
Ads, subscriptions, sponsors
An audience; the game is only the subject

Guides and writing
Ad revenue or commissions
Accurate, original work

Fan art and music
Commissions from fans
Your own creations, not Rockstar's artwork or logos

Why it matters: in each case you are paid for content you make, by people who watch or read it. Check the platform's rules and Rockstar's policies on fan content before you monetize anything.
What is not confirmed

Monetization of a GTA 6 online mode. Rockstar has said nothing about Shark Cards, a store or a currency for it.
Whether GTA Online money or purchases will carry over. Not announced.
Creator payouts. No official programme has been announced for GTA 6.
A stock market or crypto market in story mode. We have not confirmed one with two guides.

How to avoid GTA 6 money scams

Ignore "money generators". A website cannot add cash to a save on your PS5 or Xbox. These pages exist to collect logins or push surveys.
Never share your console or Rockstar account login with anyone offering money drops or "boosting".
Do not pay for early access to GTA 6 Online or a PC beta. Neither exists.
Be wary of accounts for sale. Bought accounts can be reclaimed by the seller, and trading them breaks the user agreements of the platforms involved.
Check the source. Real announcements appear on Rockstar's own site and channels first.

The legitimate way to get rich in the game
If what you actually want is a large in-game balance, these are the verified options:

Before the story ends: sell cars to Moses from Chapter 2, then rob jewelry stores from Chapter 3 and sell to Yasmani, who pays best. Chapter 2 itself asks you to save $15,000; see Prepare for Vice City.
After the story: the money cheat gives $250,000 per use, at the cost of saving and trophies for that session. The full list is in GTA 6 cheats.

What this means for you
Buy GTA 6 to play it, not to profit from it. The game costs real money and returns none, the reported position from Rockstar is that the single-player game sells nothing extra, and every "earn real money" claim so far has turned out to be a misread rumor, an unverified leak or somebody else's sales pitch. The only real money in the picture is what Take-Two makes, which we follow in how much money GTA 6 has made.
What we will add to this page
We will update this page when Rockstar announces an online mode and explains how it is paid for, if official creator tools or a PC version arrive with written terms, and if GTA+ benefits change. Any future feature that involves real money will be added only once Rockstar has published it.

Q: Can you make real money in GTA 6?
A: No. GTA 6 is a single-player game at launch, and the money you earn in it exists only inside your save. There is no feature for withdrawing, trading or selling it, and Rockstar has announced nothing of the kind.

Q: Does GTA 6 have crypto or a currency you can cash out?
A: No such feature is in the released game. The idea comes from a 2021 insider tweet about in-game cryptocurrency, which described a fictional market like GTA 5's stock exchange, and from an unverified 2026 leak that Rockstar never confirmed.

Q: Can you buy GTA 6 money with real money?
A: Not in the single-player game, according to what Rockstar North's co-studio head reportedly told Kinda Funny. Shark Cards exist in GTA Online, which runs on GTA 5; Rockstar has not said whether a GTA 6 online mode will have them.

# GTA 6 Attend Eddie Acosta's Party: Pay the $50,000 or Refuse?

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-attend-eddie-acostas-party-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-24
Status: confirmed

- Attend Eddie Acosta's Party is an optional Chapter 4 mission that opens with a text from Eddie a few days after Pool Day.
- On the Heathcliff Heights rooftop Eddie locks you out and demands $50,000; paying gets you an NFT picture with no value.
- To refuse, ride the bike over the solar panels to the next roof and take the elevator down. It costs nothing.

This GTA 6 Attend Eddie Acosta's Party walkthrough covers an optional Chapter 4 mission that is really a scam: Eddie invites you to a rooftop party, locks you outside and asks for $50,000. The short answer is do not pay. The longer answer is how to get off the roof without him.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Attend Eddie Acosta's Party (Chapter 4, optional)

Playable character
Jason or Lucia, alone

Given by
Eddie Acosta

Starts at
Heathcliff Heights, central Vice City

Requirement
Pool Day, then Eddie's text a few days later

Reward
None (paying costs $50,000)

You meet Eddie at the Y Hotel pool bar in Pool Day, when he starts talking while you fetch Lucia a drink. The invitation arrives by text later. Go alone: both guides mark the mission as solo only.
Tip: bank your cash before you go. It does not change the mission, but it is a good habit before any meeting with a stranger who talks about investments. See how to make money in GTA 6.
Objectives

Attend Eddie Acosta's party.
Meet Eddie Acosta at the elevator.

Step-by-step
1. Go to Heathcliff Heights
The building is marked on the map in central Vice City. When you walk into the lobby, your character phones Eddie automatically.
2. Ride up with Eddie
Eddie steps out of the lobby elevator and spends the ride up selling his crypto "investment".
3. The rooftop
You walk out onto the roof, and Eddie locks the door behind you. He wants $50,000 before he will open it. Both guides call this what it is: a scam.
Pay or refuse?

Choice
What happens
Cost

Pay $50,000
Eddie opens the door and joins you on the balcony; you receive an NFT picture with no value
$50,000

Refuse in dialogue
You stay locked out and have to find your own way off the roof
Nothing

Shoot at him
The door is bulletproof and he is not hurt; you still have to leave by the roof
Nothing

There is no reward on either path, so refusing is simply $50,000 better.
How to escape the roof

Take the bike that is on the roof.
Build up to full speed and ride over the row of solar panels. They work as a ramp.
Land on the neighbouring roof.
Take that building's elevator down.

Tip: give yourself the longest run-up the roof allows. Both guides stress full speed.
After the rooftop

If you did not shoot at him, Eddie comes out onto the roof after your jump and talks to you. Later he waits by the lobby elevator for his next target. You can intimidate him there; he runs out of the front door, and you can chase him.
If you did shoot at him, he runs off straight away and does not wait in the lobby.

Where players fail
Neither guide lists a fail condition. The only real mistake is paying.
Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Cash
None; minus $50,000 if you pay

Trophy progress
Does not count toward the Strangers and Freaks trophy (both guides)

100%
GTABase's page marks it as required; PowerPyx does not say

Because the two guides do not agree on whether this counts for 100%, it is safest to play it; it takes a few minutes and costs nothing if you refuse. For the side characters who do count, see GTA 6 Strangers and Freaks, and for the wider checklist see GTA 6 100% completion. Full order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: Should you pay Eddie Acosta $50,000 in GTA 6?
A: No. Both PowerPyx and GTABase say paying only gets you a worthless NFT picture. Refusing costs nothing and has no penalty.

Q: How do you get off the roof if you refuse Eddie Acosta?
A: Take the bike on the roof, ride at full speed over the solar panels, which work as a ramp, and land on the neighbouring roof. Use the elevator there to get down.

Q: How do you start Attend Eddie Acosta's Party in GTA 6?
A: Meet Eddie at the Y Hotel pool bar during Pool Day. A few days later he texts an invitation. Go to the marked building, Heathcliff Heights in central Vice City, with Jason or Lucia alone.

Q: Does Eddie Acosta count as a Strangers and Freaks mission?
A: Both guides say Eddie has only this one mission and that it does not count toward the Strangers and Freaks trophy, whichever way it ends.

- You find Felipe at a bar in Millport, chase him toward the woods and decide what happens to him.

# GTA 6 Boobie Ike: Who He Is, His Missions and What He Unlocks

URL: https://gta6box.com/characters/gta-6-boobie-ike/
Updated: 2026-11-24
Status: confirmed

- Boobie Ike is a Vice City local legend turned businessman, with interests in property, a strip club and a recording studio, and a partner in the label Only Raw Records.
- He is your landlord in Chapter 3: the Bayside apartment is his, and he expects work in return.
- His missions are Dealer's Choice (as a favor through Dre'Quan), Boobie Time and Bricked Up; Boobie Time unlocks Yasmani, the best buyer for jewelry.

GTA 6's Boobie Ike is the Vice City businessman who gives Jason and Lucia their first foothold in the city, and then makes them work for it. Rockstar introduced him before launch; the released game shows what he actually does in the story. This page covers who he is, where to find him, each of his missions and the unlocks that make them worth doing early.
Character facts come from Rockstar's official description; mission facts come from walkthroughs by two guides that agree. There are light story details for Chapter 3 below.
Boobie Ike at a glance

Detail
Info

Who he is
A Vice City local legend turned businessman (Rockstar)

Record label
Only Raw Records, with Dre'Quan Priest

Where you find him

Dealer's Choice, Boobie Time, Bricked Up

Who Boobie Ike is
Rockstar's character page describes Boobie as a local Vice City legend who has turned his reputation into legitimate-looking business: real estate, a strip club and a recording studio. He is partnered with Dre'Quan Priest, a music hustler, in the label Only Raw Records, whose signing is the rap duo Real Dimez, Bae-Luxe and Roxy.
In the game, outlets identify his club as the Jack of Hearts in Crosstown. It is the hub for his side of the story: Dre'Quan records upstairs, and Dealer's Choice and Boobie Time both start there. Our strip club guide covers the venue itself.
How you meet him
Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City. Jason calls Dre'Quan on the drive in and is told to come to the Jack of Hearts. After a walk through the club, Dre'Quan takes the pair upstairs to his boss. Boobie lets them stay in an apartment he has nearby, in Bayside.
Why it matters: the apartment is your Chapter 3 home, with your wardrobe and everything else a safehouse provides, but it is a favor with a price. See GTA 6 safehouses.
Boobie Ike's missions

Mission
Who plays
Starts at
What happens

Dealer's Choice
Started through Dre'Quan rather than Boobie himself, this is Jason's first job in the city. The Cut or Pure choice changes the scene at the sale, but both guides agree it has no effect on later missions.
Boobie Time
Boobie waits in his car in front of the club and you drive. After two stops and a visit to a club by the river, thieves take the cash bag, and Jason follows on a Seashark. Both guides say the thieves end up circling in a dead end, so there is no need to hit them at speed. The mission needs Part 1 of Dubious Provenance first.
Tip: do this one as early as you can. It ends at a smoke shop where Boobie introduces Yasmani.
Bricked Up
Late in Chapter 3, Boobie reminds the pair that living in his apartment means working for him. The pickup turns into a fight down through the building, and you begin it with pistols only, so bring body armor. The $3,500 is paid only if you take the red bag holding Boobie's bricks before you step into the hallway.
What Boobie unlocks

The Bayside apartment, your home for all of Chapter 3.
Yasmani. Both guides say he pays more for jewelry and marked bills than the other drop-offs. He follows up with Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: one item from each of three stores for $20,000.
Caught Slipping. Finishing Boobie Time and First Impressions triggers the burglary at the apartment the next time you go home.

Why it matters: Yasmani is the reason Boobie's missions pay off even when their own rewards are small. If you are holding jewelry from Chapter 2, sell it to him; see how to make money in GTA 6.
Best order for his missions

Welcome to Vice City (automatic).
Dealer's Choice, which opens most of Chapter 3.
Part 1 of Dubious Provenance, then Boobie Time straight away for Yasmani.
Save before you return home after Boobie Time and First Impressions, because Caught Slipping starts at the door.
Bricked Up when Boobie gets in touch near the end of the chapter, with body armor.

After Chapter 3
When The Cartel Heist is done, Jason and Lucia move out of Boobie's apartment and into the Y Hotel in Ocean Beach. The label's story continues without him as mission giver: Dre'Quan gives Photo/Shoot in Chapter 4.
What is not confirmed

His actor. Rockstar has not published a cast list; see GTA 6 voice actors.
His role in Chapters 4 and 5. We have not checked two walkthroughs for later appearances, so none are listed here.
The name's origin and real-world inspirations reported by some outlets are speculation and are left out.

The full cast is on our GTA 6 characters page, and every mission above is in the GTA 6 mission list.

Q: Who is Boobie Ike in GTA 6?
A: A Vice City figure Rockstar describes as a local legend turned businessman, with interests in property, a strip club and a recording studio. He co-runs the label Only Raw Records with Dre'Quan Priest and lets Jason and Lucia stay in his apartment in Chapter 3.

Q: What missions does Boobie Ike give in GTA 6?
A: Boobie Time and Bricked Up are given by him directly. Dealer's Choice is a favor he asks in return for the apartment, started through Dre'Quan. You first meet him in Welcome to Vice City.

Q: Where do you find Boobie Ike?
A: At the Jack of Hearts in Crosstown, Vice City. Boobie Time starts there, with Boobie waiting in his car in front of the club. Bricked Up starts at the Bayside apartment when he gets in touch.

Q: What does Boobie Ike unlock?
A: The Bayside apartment, and through Boobie Time the fence Yasmani, who pays more for jewelry and marked bills than the other drop-offs and offers three jewelry store jobs worth $20,000 for the set.

# GTA 6 Heavy Lifting Walkthrough: Ajax Gym, Nate and the Tail

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-heavy-lifting-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-24
Status: confirmed

- Heavy Lifting is a Chapter 4 mission from Raul that starts when you collect the hard drive from the storage locker after Lawyer Up.
- Jason and Lucia go undercover at Ajax Gym, trap Nate in a tanning bed to read his phone, then tail Kordell Grant's crew to the Grand Majestic Aparthotel.
- During the tail, keep the arrow over the bodybuilders white; it fills yellow when you get too close.

This GTA 6 Heavy Lifting walkthrough covers Raul's first Chapter 4 job: delivering the hard drive, then going undercover in a bodybuilders' gym to find out what a rival crew is planning. It is long, with about two dozen on-screen objectives, but there is no shooting. The parts that trip players up are the timed bag search and the night-time tail. PowerPyx subtitles it Bring Raul the Hard Drive.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Heavy Lifting (Chapter 4)

Jason and Lucia; the game switches between them

The storage building in Crosstown, Vice City

Requirement

None listed

Jason and Lucia rented a storage unit at the end of Caught Slipping; this mission sends you to a storage locker to fetch the hard drive.
Objectives
PowerPyx shows 24 on-screen steps; GTABase groups them into eight stages, which is the easier way to follow the mission.

Collect the hard drive.
Meet Raul on the houseboat.
Head to Ajax Gym.
Search Raina's bag.
Work out undercover.
Trap Nate.
Tail the bodybuilders.
Go up to the roof.

Step-by-step
1. Collect the hard drive
Go into the storage building, take the elevator up and take the drive from your locker. This starts the mission.
2. Meet Raul on the houseboat
Drive to Leonard County, where Raul's houseboat is docked. Board it and take the stairs on the right to the upper deck, where Karim is waiting.
Raul lays out the plan: he wants to rob a rival crew led by Kordell Grant, a bodybuilder he once worked with, and he needs to know what their next job is. GTABase adds that Karim later works out who the drive belonged to: Giorgio Gallo, heir to the Bilgeco shipping company.
3. Take the boat to Ajax Gym
You are put on a boat automatically. Steer south to Ajax Gym and pull up at the dock beside it. Lucia goes in first; follow as Jason.
Talk to the receptionist, the man in the blue tank top, then follow J-Wang on his tour of the gym.
4. Search Raina's bag (Lucia)
Back at reception the game switches to Lucia. Use the marked locker to change into gym clothes, then search Raina's backpack in the locker to the left.
Tip: both guides say to do this quickly. Go straight from your locker to hers rather than looking around the changing room first.
5. Work out undercover
Walk upstairs to the main gym.

Character
Exercise
Input (PowerPyx)

Jason
Treadmill
Tap X (A on Xbox) repeatedly to keep pace

Lucia
Leg extension
L2 + R2 (LT + RT)

When Kordell's people leave, head to the tanning salon area as Jason.
6. Trap Nate
Jason distracts the employee. As Lucia, slip past into the tanning rooms.

Nate is in the second room on the right.
Pick up the lifting strap from the floor.
Use it on the tanning bed to lock Nate inside.
Search his bag, to the right.
On his phone, open the WhatUp app, read the messages and exit.
Put the phone away and use the tanning bed again to let him out.

Once Nate has gone, leave the gym. You can change back into your normal clothes first. Jason is waiting outside by the water.
7. Tail the bodybuilders
The scene cuts to night, with you in a car behind Kordell's crew. An arrow sits above their vehicle:

Arrow
Meaning

White
You are at a safe distance

Filling yellow
You are too close; drop back

It is a long drive. Tip: GTABase suggests easing off the accelerator and letting another car slot in between you whenever the marker starts to turn.
8. Follow them to the roof
They stop at the Grand Majestic Aparthotel. Go to the entrance and follow them inside, watch them get into an elevator, then walk up as Jason calls another one. Ride it to the top floor and follow the hallway out onto the roof. The mission ends there.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists exact fail conditions, but the mission has two obvious pressure points: the bag search, which both guides tell you to do fast, and the tail, where the yellow arrow is your warning. The rule for the tail is distance first, speed second.
Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Cash
None listed (PowerPyx)

Unlocks
It's a Date! right away; Making Gainz a couple of in-game days later

100%
GTABase marks the mission as required

Heavy Lifting is the start of the long run-up to the chapter's airport job, explained in GTA 6 heists. Before you take Making Gainz, read the warning at the top of that page: it limits what Jason and Lucia can do together for a long stretch. Full order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: How do you start the mission in this GTA 6 Heavy Lifting walkthrough?
A: Finish Lawyer Up and wait for Raul to ask for the hard drive. Go to the storage building in Crosstown, take the elevator up and collect the drive from the locker.

Q: How do you trap Nate in Heavy Lifting?
A: As Lucia, slip past the tanning salon employee while Jason distracts him. Nate is in the second room on the right. Pick up the lifting strap from the floor and use it on the tanning bed, then search his bag and read the WhatUp messages on his phone.

Q: How do you tail the bodybuilders without being spotted?
A: Stay far enough back that the arrow above their car stays white. If it starts turning yellow, ease off the accelerator and let another car get between you.

Q: What is the reward for Heavy Lifting in GTA 6?
A: PowerPyx lists no reward. The mission sets up the VCIA Takedown story and unlocks the optional date It's a Date! and, a couple of days later, Making Gainz.

# GTA 6 Making Gainz Walkthrough: Nate, Workouts and Steroids

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-making-gainz-walkthrough/

- After it, Jason and Lucia cannot be seen together in public until the VCIA Takedown, so finish couple activities first.
- Nate offers Lucia steroids during the workout montage: Decline is the default, and accepting changes her physique for the rest of the game.

This GTA 6 Making Gainz walkthrough covers the mission where Lucia joins Ajax Gym for real and trains her way into Kordell Grant's crew. The workouts are simple. What needs thought are two things with lasting effects: a restriction that starts when the mission ends, and a choice about steroids in the middle of it.
Read this first: the couple restriction

If the gym has given you a taste for it, the fitness category in GTA 6 challenges lists the workout goals. From here the story splits, with Lucia working on Kordell's crew and Jason scoping out the airport. The whole chain is outlined in GTA 6 heists, and the order is in our GTA 6 mission list.

Q: Should you take the steroids in the GTA 6 Making Gainz walkthrough?
A: It is your call, but it is permanent. Both guides say Decline is the default and that accepting changes Lucia's physique for the rest of the game. Neither lists any other effect.

Q: What should you do before starting Making Gainz?
A: Finish anything that needs Jason and Lucia together in public, such as the optional date It's a Date!. After this mission they can only be together in the Y Hotel room until the VCIA Takedown.

Q: How do you start Making Gainz in GTA 6?
A: Finish Heavy Lifting and wait a couple of in-game days for Raul to contact Lucia. Then go to the planning room in Stockyard with Lucia alone.

Q: Is there a reward for Making Gainz?
A: PowerPyx lists no reward. The mission gets Lucia into Kordell Grant's circle and access to the Trauma Floor at Ajax Gym.

# GTA 6 Party Hard Walkthrough: Megamundo Rescue Step by Step

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-party-hard-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-24
Status: confirmed

- Party Hard is a Chapter 4 mission from Valentina that starts at Vice City International Airport after Lawyer Up.
- You guard telenovela star Andrés de León at the Megamundo opening, which is attacked; the mission switches between Jason and Lucia several times.
- Lucia clears the party floor with a silenced pistol and no spare ammo, and Jason finishes with a fight inside a helicopter and a landing on the roof.

This GTA 6 Party Hard walkthrough covers Valentina's security job, which starts as a chauffeur run and turns into the biggest action mission of early Chapter 4. You switch between Jason and Lucia several times, fight hand to hand, sneak across a hostage floor and end up flying a helicopter. PowerPyx subtitles it Work Personal Security.

Tip: make a manual save before you meet Valentina. The mission is long and cannot be replayed afterwards. See how to save in GTA 6.
Objectives
PowerPyx lists twelve on-screen objectives; GTABase groups the mission into nine stages.
