Step-by-step
1. Drive Andrés out of the airport
Meet Valentina at VCIA, then drive Andrés out of the airport behind the lead car.
2. Make the detour to Little Cuba
Andrés wants a drink. Go to the marked spot in Little Cuba to collect his order, then drive on to the Megamundo offices in Downtown.
3. Join the party
Follow Andrés into the building. After the scene in the lobby, follow Petra and the others into the elevator. Upstairs, go to the marked conference room to check on Andrés.
4. The attack (Jason)
Gunmen from a group both guides call FAP storm the floor and take Andrés. One stays behind.

Melee him to knock the gun out of his hand, then knock him out.
Go into the hallway and fight through the enemies there.
When the floor is clear, pick up the radio from the marked body.

5. The stairwell (Lucia)
The game switches to Lucia. Crouch-walk along the left side of the room to the stairwell, where an attacker jumps her. PowerPyx gives the prompts:

Moment
Input on PS5 (Xbox)

Fight back, then kick the gun away
Mash Square (X)

Fight from the floor
Hold R2 (RT) and mash Square (X)

Finish him with the shoe
Triangle (Y) when prompted

6. Up through the building

Jason: keep fighting while you follow the floor round to the left. More enemies come out of the offices. When it is clear, take the stairs up.
Lucia: shoot the man in the elevator, climb the stairs to a hole in the wall, climb into the vent and crawl through until you drop out on the party floor.

7. Clear the party floor (Lucia)
This is the hard part. Lucia has a silenced pistol and no spare ammunition, and there are hostages on the lower level.

Use Focus to highlight enemies before you move: L3 + R3 when you are not aiming (PowerPyx).
Take gunmen one at a time from cover. GTABase's tip is the same: being seen turns the whole floor against you.
Firing an unsilenced weapon has the same effect as being spotted.
Do not hit the hostages downstairs.

When every gunman is down, go to the lower floor and untie Valentina, then check the marked door. The Navarros are hiding behind it.
8. The helicopter (Jason)
Switch to Jason and sprint to the roof. The kidnappers' helicopter is already lifting off.

Press X (A) to jump on.
Mash Square (X) to fight the kidnappers inside.
Press X (A) when prompted to dodge.
Once they are kicked out, hold R2 (RT) and mash X (A) to pull Andrés back in.

9. Land on the helipad
Take the controls, fly back to the Megamundo building and land on the rooftop helipad. That completes the mission. If you have not flown much yet, our planes and helicopters page lists what else you can fly.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists fail conditions. The stage that costs people time is the party floor: there is no spare ammunition, so missed shots matter, and one alert makes every remaining gunman search for you. Use Focus before each shot rather than after.

The two guides number this mission differently because they order it either side of Heavy Lifting; both only require Lawyer Up, so you can play them in either order. Full order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: How do you start the mission in this GTA 6 Party Hard walkthrough?
A: Finish Lawyer Up and accept Valentina's security job. The mission starts when you meet her at Vice City International Airport (VCIA).

Q: How do you clear the party floor in Party Hard?
A: As Lucia, use the silenced pistol and pick off gunmen one at a time from cover. There is no spare ammo, so use Focus (L3 + R3 when not aiming) to find each enemy first, and do not hit the hostages on the lower floor.

Q: What happens if you are spotted on the party floor?
A: Both guides say the enemies start hunting for you, which also happens if you fire an unsilenced gun. Neither guide lists it as an instant fail.

Q: What is the reward for Party Hard in GTA 6?
A: PowerPyx lists no reward. Finishing it unlocks Photo/Shoot and the missable optional mission Bad Driver!.

# GTA 6 Safehouses: Every Home by Chapter and What It Does

URL: https://gta6box.com/map/gta-6-safehouses/
Updated: 2026-11-24
Status: partly

- GTA 6 gives you one safehouse per chapter rather than a list to buy: Jason's house, the Starlet Motel, the Bayside apartment and Room 701 at the Y Hotel.
- Each home is lost for good when its chapter ends, so finish anything tied to it before the chapter finale.
- Safehouses hold your wardrobe and a bed; saving is done from the pause menu anywhere, not at home.

GTA 6 safehouses work differently from earlier games: instead of buying properties, Jason and Lucia are given one home per chapter, and each one is taken away when the chapter ends. This page lists every home confirmed so far, in story order, with where it is, how you get it, what it is for and the exact mission that closes it.
Everything here comes from walkthroughs by at least two guides that agree. Chapter 5 is not included yet.
All safehouses at a glance

Chapter
Safehouse
Where
You get it in
You lose it in

Ocean Beach

There is also one place that is storage rather than a home: the unit at Big House Storage, from Caught Slipping.
What a safehouse does

Wardrobe. Everything you buy or pick up is kept in the wardrobe at your current safehouse, and that is where you build outfits. See how to change clothes in GTA 6.
Bed. At Jason's house, sleeping skips the night and restores health and stamina, according to KeenGamer.
Fast travel target. The RydeMe app can take you to your current safehouse; see GTA 6 fast travel.
Mission starts. Several missions begin at home, including chapter finales.

What it does not do is save your game. Saving is in the pause menu under Game and works anywhere in free roam; see how to save in GTA 6.
Chapter 1: Jason's house, Key Lento
Jason lives rent-free on a property owned by Brian Heder in the Keys, in return for helping with shakedowns. It is the only home with its own side content: four repair jobs, covered in Jason's house projects, which close when Lucia is released. Lucia moves in after Coming Home.
How you lose it: in Home Sweet Home, Lucia finds intruders in the house, a fire starts and the house explodes. PowerPyx says there is not enough time to reach the cash stash before it goes.
Tip: finish the house projects and anything else you want in the Keys before Tourist Trap, because the last three missions of Chapter 1 run without a break.
Chapter 2: the Starlet Motel, Kelly County
Chapter 1 ends at a motel, and Chapter 2 opens there with What's in the Bag?. Jason is stuck in bed at first, so Lucia stocks the room in Just Moved In. The motel's coffee room is also where the chapter's money goal, Prepare for Vice City, begins.
How you lose it: Checking Out, the chapter finale, starts at the bathroom door in your room once you have $15,000 and every other Chapter 2 main mission done. PowerPyx and GTABase both say starting it removes the motel as your home for good.
Tip: do not touch the bathroom door until you have finished the Chapter 2 side content you care about.
Chapter 3: the Bayside apartment, Vice City
In Welcome to Vice City, Boobie Ike lets the couple stay in an apartment he owns near the Jack of Hearts. To get in, park in the covered spot, walk round to the front, climb to the second floor and take the first door in front of you. Both guides note that the door opposite the parking spots works as a shortcut afterwards.
The apartment comes with strings. Boobie treats the stay as a debt, which is how Dealer's Choice and Bricked Up start; more on him in Boobie Ike. It is also burgled: Caught Slipping triggers at the apartment door after Boobie Time and First Impressions.
How you lose it: after The Cartel Heist, returning to the apartment starts Ocean Beach, and the pair pack up and leave for good.
Big House Storage: not a home, but yours
At the end of Caught Slipping, Jason buys a unit at Big House Storage, south of the apartment, as a safer place to keep their things after the burglary. You return to a storage locker to collect that drive at the start of Heavy Lifting in Chapter 4.
Chapter 4: Room 701 at the Y Hotel
Valentina puts the couple in a suite at the Y Hotel as part of her money-laundering operation. Ride the elevator to the 7th floor, turn left and walk to the far end of the hallway. Both guides say new outfits become available through the suite's wardrobe from this chapter on.
The hotel adds two conveniences:

Santino, the concierge, gives the mission Company Cars, which hands each lead a free car.
The hotel's car service works as a free taxi from the front of the building, per both guides.

Why it matters: from Making Gainz until the VCIA Takedown, this room is the only place Jason and Lucia can be together, so it becomes the base for anything that needs both of them.
Checklist before every chapter finale

Make a manual save in a slot you will keep.
Finish missable and optional missions for that chapter; the mission list marks the points of no return.
Finish anything tied to the home itself, such as Jason's house projects in Chapter 1.
Bank your cash before the finale, since carried cash is lost when you are wasted or busted.

What is not confirmed

Chapter 5. We have not yet checked two walkthroughs for the final chapter, so we do not say whether the Y Hotel stays your home.
Buying property. No two guides we have read confirm purchasable safehouses in story mode.
Garages and vehicle storage at each home. Details differ between guides and will be added when they agree.

For the districts around the two city homes, see our Vice City guide; for the full region list, see the GTA 6 map.

Q: How many GTA 6 safehouses are there?
A: The walkthroughs we have checked show four homes in the first four chapters, one per chapter: Jason's house in Key Lento, the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, the Bayside apartment in Vice City and Room 701 at the Y Hotel. Chapter 5 is not covered yet.

Q: Can you buy safehouses in GTA 6?
A: None of the story homes is bought: each is provided by the story. We have not found two guides that confirm purchasable homes in the single-player game, so we do not list any.

Q: Do you need a safehouse to save in GTA 6?
A: No. You save from the pause menu under Game, anywhere in free roam. Sleeping in the bed at Jason's house skips the night and restores health and stamina but does not save.

Q: Can you go back to an old safehouse in GTA 6?
A: No. Jason's house is destroyed at the end of Chapter 1, the Starlet Motel stops being your home when Checking Out begins, and the pair clear out the Bayside apartment at the start of Chapter 4.

# What Is GTA 6? A Plain Guide for People Who Have Never Played GTA

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/what-is-gta-6/
Updated: 2026-11-24
Status: confirmed

- GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) is an open-world crime game from Rockstar Games, released on November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
- You play two leads, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, across the fictional state of Leonida, Rockstar's version of Florida, including Vice City.
- It costs $79.99, is rated M (17+), needs up to 212 GB, and is single-player only at launch, with no PC version announced.

GTA 6 is Grand Theft Auto VI, an open-world crime game from Rockstar Games in which you play a couple, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, across a fictional version of Florida called Leonida. It came out on November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, thirteen years after GTA 5. If you have heard the name everywhere and never played a GTA game, this page explains what it is, what you actually do in it, what it costs, who it is suitable for and how to start, with a link to a deeper guide for each point.
The facts below are confirmed by Rockstar or by at least two independent launch guides.
GTA 6 at a glance

Question
Answer

Full name
Grand Theft Auto VI

Platforms

Genre

What kind of game it is
Grand Theft Auto is a series of open-world games: you are dropped into a large, detailed place and can go almost anywhere, on foot or in any vehicle you can get into. A long story is told through missions, and between missions the world is yours. GTA 6 is the newest main entry, and it is played from behind your character by default, with an optional first-person mode.
Why it matters: you do not need to have played the earlier games. Each GTA has its own cast and story, and GTA 6 explains its systems as it goes.
Where it is set
The game takes place in the state of Leonida, Rockstar's take on Florida. Rockstar names six regions: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park. Vice City is the series' version of Miami, first seen in 2002's GTA: Vice City.
Rockstar's developers say the map is about twice the size of GTA 5's, with far more buildings you can enter.
Tip: the story starts in the Keys and does not reach Vice City until Chapter 3, so do not expect the neon skyline in the first hours. See the GTA 6 map, how big it is and our Vice City guide.
Who you play
There are two playable leads.

Jason Duval grew up around grifters, joined the Army to get away, and now works for drug runners in the Keys.
Lucia Caminos grew up in Liberty City, learned to fight from her father and has just been released from Leonida Penitentiary. She is the first female lead in a mainline 3D GTA.

They are a couple, and many missions put both in the same scene. From Chapter 2 you can switch between them in free play.
Why it matters: the relationship is a system, not only a storyline. Time spent together is tracked and feeds into rewards. The wider cast is on our GTA 6 characters page.
What the story is about
Without spoilers: a job goes wrong, and Jason and Lucia are pushed out of the Keys, through the countryside and into Vice City, where the scores get bigger and the people they owe get more dangerous.
The story is a playable prologue plus five chapters. Launch guides count 91 main missions, and more than 100 if you include short tasks and optional ones. The only playtime figure from Rockstar is about 80 hours, from one studio head's own playthrough with optional goals included.
Tip: missions cannot be replayed after you finish them, and each chapter ends with a point of no return. Our mission list marks those points, and how long GTA 6 is breaks down the numbers.
What you actually do
A typical hour mixes several of these:

Story missions: driving, shooting, stealth, chases by car, boat, bike and helicopter, and multi-part heists.
Making money: selling stolen cars, robbing stores and jewelry shops, later bank vaults.
Side characters and activities: optional missions, races on real circuits, shooting ranges, workouts, fishing and more.
Collecting: cards, hidden flamingos, watches and photo scans.
Just living there: radio in the car or on foot, clothes, haircuts, dates.

Why it matters: almost everything optional counts toward something. There are 80 challenges, a 35-line checklist for 100% and 55 trophies. Start with how to play GTA 6.
How the police work
Crime attracts a wanted level of up to six stars. Under the stars, red heat icons show what the police know about you: your face, your clothes, your vehicle. Getting away means changing what they can recognise, not only driving out of sight.
Tip: if a chase keeps restarting, swap cars and change clothes. The full system is in GTA 6 wanted level explained.
How it differs from GTA 5
If GTA 5 is the one you know, these are the headline changes:

Why it matters: habits from GTA 5 can cost you here, especially walking around with a full wallet. All 14 major changes are compared in GTA 6 new features.
What it costs and which edition to buy

Boxed copies contain a download code, not a disc. For most new players the Standard Edition is enough, because the Ultimate extras are items, not story. Details: GTA 6 price and editions.
What you need to play it

A PS5 (any model, including Pro) or an Xbox Series X or Series S.
Up to 212 GB of free storage and an internet connection for the download, even with a boxed copy.
Every console targets 30 frames per second; there is no 60 FPS mode.

It does not run on PS4, Xbox One or Switch 2. See GTA 6 platforms and the file size guide.
Who it is suitable for
GTA 6 is an adult game. It is rated M (Mature 17+) in North America, PEGI 18 in Europe and the UK, and R18 in Australia and New Zealand, with ESRB descriptors that include blood and gore, nudity, strong language, and use of drugs and alcohol. It is a crime story about adults, and it is not suitable for children.
Tip for parents: console parental controls can block the game by age rating. Our age rating guide lists every content descriptor.
What GTA 6 does not have (yet)

No online multiplayer. Rockstar describes the launch game as a single-player experience and has not dated an online mode. See GTA 6 online.
No PC version. None has been announced. See GTA 6 on PC.
No cheats from the start. The 61 cheats unlock only after the story. See GTA 6 cheats.
No way to earn real money. See can you make real money in GTA 6.

How to start: your first evening

Buy the Standard Edition unless you specifically want the extra items.
Start the download early. At around 210 GB it can take hours.
Play the prologue and the first missions in order. They teach driving, shooting and the phone.
Save by hand from the pause menu under Game. There are 15 slots; keep one per chapter.
Bank your cash once the BuckMe app opens, because carried cash is lost when you are wasted or busted.
Do not rush to Vice City. The Keys have their own side content, some of which closes at the end of Chapter 1.

Is it worth playing?
Critics think so: GTA 6 launched with a Metacritic score of 99 and top marks from the largest outlets, with the 30 FPS target as the main complaint. If you like open-world games, crime stories or simply exploring a place at your own pace, it is the most complete example of the form so far. If you want competitive multiplayer today, or you play only on PC, it is worth waiting. The reviews are summarised in GTA 6 reviews.
What we will add to this page
We will update this explainer when Rockstar announces an online mode or a PC version, when official sales figures are published, and if a patch adds a performance mode. Prices and platform details will be corrected as soon as they change.

Q: What is GTA 6?
A: GTA 6, officially Grand Theft Auto VI, is an open-world action game by Rockstar Games. You play a couple, Jason and Lucia, through a crime story in Leonida, a fictional state based on Florida, and can explore its cities, swamps and islands freely between missions.

Q: What is GTA 6 about?
A: It follows Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, who start out working for drug runners in the Leonida Keys and are pushed toward Vice City and bigger robberies. The story runs through a prologue and five chapters.

Q: What can you play GTA 6 on?
A: PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. It is not on PS4, Xbox One or Switch 2, and Rockstar has not announced a PC version.

# GTA 6 Another Life Walkthrough: Flashback and BuckMe Black

- Another Life is the second mission of Chapter 4 and starts automatically after Ocean Beach, with Lucia as the playable lead.
- It is a short flashback with six prompts and no combat, choices or fail conditions.
- Both guides list a BuckMe Black account with a $2,000,000 limit and the Vice City, Baby! trophy as rewards.

This GTA 6 Another Life walkthrough covers Lucia's flashback mission, the second mission of Chapter 4. It takes a few minutes, has no enemies and cannot really go wrong, but it matters for two reasons: it unlocks a new bank account tier and a story trophy. We keep the story details light here.

Status: partly

- GTA 6 boats include the Speedophile Seashark jet ski, Pegassi Speeder, Shitzu Squalo and Tropic speedboats, the Dinka Marquis sailboat and airboats for the swamps.
- Boats are part of the story from the first missions: Gone Fishing starts on the water, and Boobie Time ends in a Seashark chase.
- After the story, cheats spawn the Speeder 700 GT and the Airboat 09; the Shitzu Squalo is an Ultimate Edition vehicle.

GTA 6 boats matter more than in any earlier game: Leonida is a state of keys, canals, rivers and swamps, and several story missions are fought on the water. This page lists the boats that launch guides agree on, the missions where you use them, where to find one in free roam and which boats the cheats spawn. Rockstar has not published an official list, so the page is marked partly confirmed.

Jet skis and speedboats
The Seashark jet ski is the boat you will use most in the story. In Boobie Time, thieves grab a cash bag and Jason chases them down the river on one; you ride over the bag to pick it up. Day Release includes a jet ski race, and Dubious Provenance has another Seashark chase.
The Pegassi Speeder and the Shitzu Tropic are the open-water speedboats. The Shitzu Squalo is one of the seven vehicles named in Rockstar's edition descriptions, and GamesRadar+ notes that the Ultimate Edition version comes with an explosives crate on board.
Tip: take a jet ski rather than a speedboat for chases in canals and rivers; every river chase in the story so far is ridden on a Seashark.
Airboats for the swamps
Airboats skim over shallow water and mud where propeller boats get stuck, which makes them the right choice in Grassrivers and the Everglades-style swamps of Leonida. Guides list a standard Airboat and the Airboat 09, which is also a cheat spawn.

Where to find a boat
Boats sit at docks and marinas along the coast and in the keys. The easiest early spot is the docks by the houses in Key Lento, near Jason's home, where Home Sweet Home lets you take a boat or a jet ski.
Why it matters: the Keys are linked by one long highway, so the water is often the more direct route between islands.

Q: What boats are in GTA 6?
A: Guides name the Speedophile Seashark jet ski, Pegassi Speeder, Shitzu Squalo, Shitzu Tropic, Dinka Marquis, Nagasaki Dinghy, Clarion, Crest Kayak and swamp airboats, including the Airboat 09.

Q: Where do you find boats in GTA 6?
A: At docks and marinas along the coast, such as the docks by the houses in Key Lento, where you can take a boat or jet ski. Story missions also hand you boats.

Q: Can you spawn a boat with a cheat in GTA 6?

# GTA 6 Bricked Up Walkthrough: Take the Red Bag for $3,500

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-bricked-up-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-23
Status: confirmed

- Bricked Up is a late Chapter 3 mission from Boobie Ike that starts at the Bayside apartment after Hidden Charges.
- The $3,500 payment and the Professional bonus depend on picking up the red bag before you leave the first room.
- Park outside the red area around Venture Apartments in Rockridge, or your car is impounded during the mission.

This GTA 6 Bricked Up walkthrough covers Boobie's pickup job at Venture Apartments, which turns into a police raid and a fight down through the building to a window. Boobie reminds Jason and Lucia that while they live in his apartment they work for him, and sends them to collect cocaine bricks owed by a gang called San4San. PowerPyx subtitles the mission Return to the Apartment.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission

Playable characters

Given by
Boobie Ike

Starts at
Bayside apartment, Vice City

Requirement
Hidden Charges and the other remaining Chapter 3 main missions

Reward

You begin the fight with pistols only, so bring body armor.
Objectives

Go to Venture Apartments.
Park away from Venture Apartments.
Ask for Raymond in the lobby.
Escape Venture Apartments.
Help Lucia.
Get in a car.
Pick up Jason.
Lose the cops.
Go to the Jack of Hearts.

These are PowerPyx's nine lines; GTABase covers the same route in six stages.
Step-by-step
1. Back at the apartment
Return to the Bayside apartment when Boobie gets in touch. He is asleep there, and sends you both to pick up the bricks.
2. Drive to Rockridge and park away
Venture Apartments is in Rockridge. Lucia suggests parking out of sight, and the map shows a red area around the building.
Tip: leave the car outside the red area. You can park at the door, but both guides say the vehicle is impounded during the mission if you do. Getting it back means a trip like the one in Impounded Vehicle.
Walk to the front entrance.
3. Ask for Raymond
In the lobby, turn right and talk to the man standing by the elevator. Upstairs, walk down the hallway and knock on the red door with a slot in the middle.
4. Escape the raid
Captain Méndez and his dirty cops raid the building.

Take the red bag first. It is near the end of the table in the first room. These are Boobie's bricks: no bag, no $3,500 and no Professional bonus.
Pick up the longarms that police drop. You start with pistols.
Head back down the hallway towards the elevators. Enemies come from the side doors and from the larger room before the elevators.
Take the stairs at the end of the hallway or the elevator. If the elevator stops, press X on PS5 or A on Xbox (per PowerPyx) to open the doors.
The third floor has no lights. A police weapon with a flashlight on it makes enemies much easier to see.

5. Out through the window
Fight down through the third and second floors. At the end of the last hallway Raymond steps out and points you into the apartment on his left. Lucia climbs out of the window; interact with her to help her drop down.
You switch to Lucia. Run to the parking lot to the south, take a car and drive back under the window to pick up Jason.
6. Lose the cops
A police helicopter is above you from the start, so this escape takes longer than most. Put distance between you and the building and watch for roadblocks. Our wanted level guide explains how search areas work.
7. Go to the Jack of Hearts
Boobie is waiting in his car in front of the Jack of Hearts. Stay out of the police search area on the way; you can change cars if you want.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists formal fail conditions. What costs you:

Walking out without the red bag. The payment and the bonus both depend on it.
Parking at the entrance. The car is impounded.
Rushing the dark third floor. Enemies wait around corners; use a weapon light.

Optional goals and rewards

100%
GTABase marks the mission as required

Bricked Up is another job for Boobie, whom you first drove around in Boobie Time. After it, PowerPyx's order has South Leonida Real Estate and then the chapter finale; see GTA 6 heists. Full order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: Where is the red bag in the GTA 6 Bricked Up walkthrough?
A: In the first room behind the red door, near the end of the table. Take it before you step into the hallway; it holds Boobie's bricks.

Q: How much does Bricked Up pay in GTA 6?
A: $3,500, but only if you carry Boobie's bricks out. Both guides say the red bag also counts for the Professional bonus.

Q: Where should you park in Bricked Up?
A: Outside the red area marked on the map around Venture Apartments. A car left inside it is impounded while you are in the building.

Q: How do you unlock Bricked Up in GTA 6?
A: Finish Hidden Charges and the other remaining Chapter 3 main missions, then return to the Bayside apartment when Boobie gets in touch.

- GTA 6 has hundreds of vehicles under fictional brands; launch guides have named well over 100 cars so far, from the Ganado pickup to the Zorrusso supercar.
- You cannot just keep a stolen car: from Chapter 2 you register it at Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn, and later at Pay 'n' Spray.
- Unregistered cars disappear when you leave them, so register the cars you want and keep a garage slot free.

GTA 6 cars number in the hundreds, all under fictional brands, and launch guides have already named well over 100 of them. This page lists every car that at least two launch guides name, sorted by class, then covers bikes, boats and aircraft, the vehicles tied to the editions, and the part most players get wrong: a stolen car is not yours until you register it. How to steal, register and keep a car
Stealing a car does not make it yours. Guides agree that an unregistered car disappears once you leave it, die or quit, so registration is the real way to build a garage.

Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Registration unlocks in the Moses walkthrough, which also gives Lucia the Slim Jim for quiet break-ins, the Scooter Bros app that delivers your car, and a free registered vehicle.
Scan before you steal. Use the WAiNK phone app to check a car's tracker. Moses only takes cars with no tracker, and he refuses cars stolen right next to his garage.
Respray and register. Drive into Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn, pick a new colour, then choose Register instead of Sell.
Keep a slot free. You start with one garage slot, so register a car you will actually drive. More space comes with new properties as the story goes on.
Use Pay 'n' Spray later. After Welcome to Vice City, Moses texts that Pay 'n' Spray shops can buy and register cars with standard trackers. Cars with advanced trackers need the Key Cloner from Chapter 3.

Tip: a registered car used in a crime and left inside the police search area can be impounded. The Scooter Bros app returns it for a fee; the Impounded Vehicle walkthrough covers it.
Selling stolen cars
The cars you do not keep are income. Moses buys untracked cars from Chapter 2, Pay 'n' Spray buys cars with standard trackers later, and Randy buys high-end cars from Chapter 3. Cars in good condition sell for more. Payouts are in how to make money in GTA 6.
What is not confirmed yet

Top speeds. Rockstar has not published any, and the "fastest car" lists from before launch are estimates. We will rank cars only with tested numbers.
The exact number of vehicles. Guides count differently, from about 300 to more than 500 depending on whether variants count.
Customisation menus for every car.

What we will add to this page

A tested top-speed ranking by class
Where each car spawns, starting with the supercars
Customisation shops and their prices

Q: What cars are in GTA 6?
A: Launch guides list sports cars such as the Banshee, Coquette D10 and Itali GTO, supercars such as the Zorrusso, Tempesta, Emerus and Thrax, muscle cars such as the Dominator and Gauntlet, and SUVs, pickups and classics. The full list by class is on this page.

Q: How do you keep a car in GTA 6?
A: Register it. From the Chapter 2 mission Moses, take a car without a tracker to Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn, respray it and choose Register. Unregistered cars vanish once you leave them.

Q: Can you buy cars in GTA 6?
A: Launch guides describe stealing and registering cars rather than a dealership. Your first registration with Moses is free, and some vehicles come from missions, editions or cheats.

Q: Are there real car brands in GTA 6?
A: No. Vehicles use fictional brands such as Pegassi, Grotti, Vapid and Declasse, with designs that resemble real cars.

# GTA 6 Company Cars Walkthrough: Which Two Cars to Pick

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-company-cars-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-23
Status: confirmed

- Company Cars is a Chapter 4 mission given by Santino, the Y Hotel concierge, after Pool Day.
- You choose one free car for Jason and one for Lucia at Status Auto Imports, and you keep both.
- Both guides name the Pfister Comet S2 as the fastest choice on base stats and suggest the truck or SUV for a balanced pair.

This GTA 6 Company Cars walkthrough covers the mission where Jason and Lucia each pick a free high-end car, paid for by Valentina. It is short and has no combat, but you keep both cars, so it helps to know what is on offer before you sit in the first driver's seat. PowerPyx subtitles the mission Speak to the Concierge.

# GTA 6 Company Property Walkthrough: Save Every Crate

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-company-property-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-23
Status: confirmed

- Company Property is a Cartel Heist prep mission in Chapter 3, given by Brian Heder at Skeeter's bar in the south of Hamlet.
- The cargo Lucia saves in the truck chase decides how many explosive charges you get in Hidden Charges.
- Keeping every cargo box earns a Professional bonus; the mission ends with Jason crash-landing Pete's plane.

This GTA 6 Company Property walkthrough covers the weapons pickup that supplies the Cartel Heist with explosives. Brian calls in a favour from an old smuggling contact, Pilot Pete, and the handover at a country airfield is raided within minutes. Jason leaves by plane, Lucia by truck, and how much cargo she keeps matters two missions later. PowerPyx subtitles the mission Meet Brian.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission

Jason and Lucia

Brian Heder

Starts at
Skeeter's bar, south side of Hamlet

Requirement

No cash; the cargo you save sets your explosive charges in Hidden Charges

Bring body armor and a full rifle if you have them. The first half is a long fight on foot.
Objectives

Follow Brian.
Drive to the airfield.
Place the weapons crate in the truck.
Pick up a weapons crate.
Escape with Pete.
Escape the area.
Protect the cargo.
Return to the planning room.
Land the plane.

These are the nine lines PowerPyx lists. GTABase groups the same mission into six stages.
Step-by-step
1. Meet Brian at Skeeter's
Go to Skeeter's in the south of Hamlet and talk to Brian at the bar. Raul has asked him to return a favour: a weapons delivery flown in by Pilot Pete. Follow Brian out and get in his truck.
2. Load the crates
Drive to the airfield south of Hamlet and wait for Pete's plane. Pete hands over a crate; carry it to the back of Brian's truck. Then walk back, pick up a second crate from the ground and load that one too.
3. Fight off the raid (Jason)
IAA agents and police arrive. Lucia leaves with Brian in the truck and you stay as Jason.

Follow Pete through the garage door on the right into the hangar.
Opposite the door there is an assault rifle and health items. Take both.
Deal with the agents who come in, then follow Pete out of the back door.
Head south down the road and climb onto the roof Pete uses. Shoot the cars coming down the road from up there.

4. Take off
Follow Pete through the trees and across the runway to the second hangar. Watch the far side of the runway for more cars. Jason jumps into the plane automatically. Taxi out of the hangar, turn left onto the runway, hold full speed and pull up as early as you can so the cars cannot block you.
5. Protect the cargo (Lucia)
The game switches to Lucia in the back of Brian's truck with an LMG and unlimited ammo. Shoot pursuing vehicles before they ram the truck: every hit can knock a cargo box off.
Tip: reload only when nothing is directly behind you. Both guides say that keeping all the cargo earns a Professional bonus, and each box lost costs one explosive charge in Hidden Charges.
When Lucia gets into the car, follow the road objective until the game switches back to Jason.
6. Crash-land the plane (Jason)
The plane is too damaged to keep flying. Bring it down on the colourful field to the right of the river. Landing completes the mission.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists formal fail conditions. What costs you:

Skipping the rifle in the hangar. The fight to the second hangar is long.
Reloading the LMG at the wrong moment. A vehicle that reaches the truck knocks cargo off.
A slow take-off. Cars drive onto the runway; lift off early.

Q: Where does the GTA 6 Company Property walkthrough start?
A: At Skeeter's, a bar on the south side of Hamlet. Talk to Brian at the bar after finishing Security Expert, follow him outside and get in his truck.

Q: What happens if you lose cargo in Company Property?
A: Each box knocked off Brian's truck means one fewer explosive charge in Hidden Charges, and fewer charges mean less time in The Cartel Heist.

Q: Where do you land the plane in Company Property?
A: On the colourful field to the right of the river. The plane is too damaged to keep flying, so both guides say to bring it down there.

Q: Is Company Property required for 100% in GTA 6?
A: Yes, according to GTABase, which lists it as a mandatory mission.

Most of the shoot plays out by itself. The parts you control, in order:

Driving shots. Hold the accelerator (R2 on PS5, RT on Xbox, per PowerPyx) to keep the car moving and use the left stick to steer it around the circle.
The street scene. When the car stops after the drive through the city, get out. Pull the man off Roxy, then fight the second man who comes at you.
Wrecking the car. After the girls film themselves smashing the car, Lucia is handed a bat. You can take a few swings yourself.
Spray paint. Shake the can (X on PS5, A on Xbox), then spray the side of the car with R2 (RT).

3. Escape DWNPLY's crew
DWNPLY and his friends turn up. Drive away and keep going until every chasing car has dropped off and you are outside the red area on the map.
Tip: you do not have to fight. Both guides describe the goal as getting clear: lose the cars and leave the red area.
4. Drop the car at the studio
Drive to the studio. Arriving completes the mission.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists fail conditions, and the shoot itself is hard to get wrong. The one place to lose time is the chase: turning back into the red area keeps DWNPLY's crew on you.

Q: How do you unlock Cooties in GTA 6?
A: Finish Ride or Die, then wait a couple of in-game days. Dre'Quan calls about the video shoot and a marker appears in Crosstown.

Q: Who do you play in the GTA 6 Cooties walkthrough?

# GTA 6 Early Access: Did Any Edition Let You Play Early?

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/gta-6-early-access/
Updated: 2026-11-23
Status: confirmed

- GTA 6 had no early access: the Standard and Ultimate editions both unlocked at midnight local time on November 19, 2026.
- The only head starts were pre-loading from November 10 and the rolling launch, which let New Zealand play first.
- No early access has been announced for an online mode, a PC version or story content, so treat any offer of it as a scam.

GTA 6 early access did not exist: no edition, pre-order or subscription let you play before the game unlocked at midnight local time on November 19, 2026. That is unusual in a year when many big releases sell a few days of head start with their most expensive edition, and it is why the question is still being searched after launch. This page sets out what each edition really included, the three legitimate ways some players started sooner than others, and what "early access" could mean for the parts of GTA 6 that have not arrived yet: an online mode, a PC version and future content.
How we checked: edition contents and launch times come from Rockstar and its support pages; everything else is reported by at least two independent outlets, and anything that rests on reports alone is marked as such.
GTA 6 early access at a glance

Question
Answer

Early access with the Standard Edition ($79.99)
No

Early access with the Ultimate Edition ($99.99)
No

Early access with GTA+
None listed among the reported GTA 6 member benefits

Pre-load
Yes, from November 10, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S

Unlock time

First region to play
New Zealand, about 11:00 UTC on November 18

Boxed copies in shops
From November 12, with a download code, not a disc

Early access to an online mode
Nothing announced

Early access on PC
Nothing announced; no PC version exists

No edition included early access
Rockstar sold two editions. The Standard Edition is the full game. The Ultimate Edition adds an upgrade with 16 extra in-game items: vehicles, weapons, clothing, locations and activities. Neither listing mentioned playing early, and both unlocked at the same moment. Forbes made the same point a week before launch, in a piece about pre-ordering "despite no early access".
Why it matters: if you are deciding between the two editions today, a head start was never part of the difference. You are choosing between the game and the game plus items. The full breakdown is in GTA 6 price and editions and GTA 6 Ultimate Edition.
What pre-ordering actually got you
A pre-order came with three things, none of them time:

The Vintage Vice City Pack, included with any purchase made before November 20, 2026: a '55 Vapid Stanier with a garage, outfits and hairstyles for both leads, and a weapon pattern.
One month of GTA+ with a digital pre-order.
Pre-loading, so the download was finished before midnight.

Tip: the pack's window closed the day after launch, so a copy bought now does not include it. Details of the items are on our Vintage Vice City Pack page.
Pre-load was the only official head start
Pre-loading opened on November 10, nine days before launch, on both consoles. Rockstar published a pre-load FAQ and a table of regional times on its support site. With an install of up to 212 GB, those nine days mattered more than they do for most games: on a 100 Mbps line the download alone takes close to five hours.
Pre-loading put the files on your console. It did not start the game. The licence stayed locked until midnight, and two updates released before launch (on November 13 and November 16) had to be installed as well.
Why it matters: for anyone on a slow connection, pre-load was the difference between playing at midnight and playing the next afternoon. If you are buying now, the download is the whole wait; see GTA 6 file size for sizes and how to make room.
The rolling launch: why New Zealand played first
GTA 6 did not unlock at one worldwide moment. It unlocked at midnight on November 19 in each region, so New Zealand started first, at about 11:00 UTC on November 18, followed by Australia, Asia, Europe and the Americas. Players in Auckland were roughly a day ahead of players in Los Angeles without paying anything extra.
Why it matters: this is the closest thing GTA 6 had to early access, and it was decided by geography, not by edition. The full timetable, including the question of whether the United States unlocked at once or by time zone, is in what time GTA 6 came out.
The New Zealand trick
Because of the rolling launch, the usual workaround appeared: set your console's region to New Zealand and start when New Zealand does. GamesRadar+ published instructions before launch. VICE reported that the method worked on Xbox and warned that there might be a catch on PS5.
The difference between the consoles is long-standing. An Xbox lets you change its location in the system settings and restart. A PlayStation account's region is fixed when the account is created, so the PS5 route means buying the game on an account from that region in the first place.
Tip: the trick is history now that the game is live everywhere, but it will come up again with the next big release. It is a settings change, not a hack, yet it was never something Rockstar offered, and on PlayStation it only helps people who planned for it before buying.
Boxed copies arrived a week early, without a way to play
Boxed copies of GTA 6 were in shops and in buyers' hands from November 12, and outlets ran photos of the packaging a week before launch. In earlier console generations, a broken street date meant some people played early. That did not apply here: the GTA 6 box contains a download code rather than a disc. Redeeming the code started the same pre-load as a digital purchase, and the game stayed locked until midnight like every other copy.
Why it matters: this is one practical effect of the discless box. An early delivery gave you a head start on the download and nothing more. What the box does and does not contain is covered in GTA 6 physical copy.
Who really did play before November 19
Two groups, neither of them customers:

Reviewers. Critics received the game ahead of release under embargo. Reviews were published on November 18, and GTA 6 opened at 99 on Metacritic; see GTA 6 reviews.
One fan, according to reports. In January 2026, PC Gamer and other outlets reported that Rockstar had responded to a public appeal on behalf of a terminally ill fan who wanted to play the game early. Rockstar did not comment publicly on the details, so we go no further than that.

Why it matters: neither case was a product you could buy. When a site says early access "existed", this is usually what it is stretching.
GTA+ members got perks, not a head start
Rockstar set out GTA+ benefits for GTA 6 shortly before launch. As reported by Engadget, TweakTown and others, they include discounts in in-game stores, boosts to earnings and free bike rentals. None of the reports we found lists early access to the game or to anything inside it.
Tip: digital pre-orders came with one month of GTA+, so check whether yours is set to renew before you are charged for a second month. Treat the current list of benefits as a snapshot, and judge it by what you would use this month.
Early access to GTA 6's online mode
There is nothing to get early access to yet. Rockstar describes GTA 6 at launch as a single-player experience and has not announced a name, a date or a test phase for a new online mode. No beta sign-up exists, and neither the Ultimate Edition nor GTA+ has been described as a route into one.
Why it matters: an online mode is the most likely place for a real early-access offer to appear in future, which also makes it the favourite subject of fake ones. We track every official statement in GTA 6 online.
Early access on PC
No PC version of GTA 6 has been announced. Take-Two's chief executive has said publicly that console players are the series' core audience and are served first, and the company has given no PC date. That means there is no PC pre-order, no Steam or Epic listing for the game, and no PC key.
Since launch, PC Gamer and others have reported on unofficial attempts to get a console build running on PC. That is not early access. It is not a Rockstar release, and files offered under that label are a common way to spread malware.
Tip: if you want to play before a PC version exists, the only real option is a console. Our GTA 6 on PC page keeps the port history and every official comment in one place, and GTA 6 platforms lists what runs the game today.
How to spot a fake early access offer
Fake "early access" pages were common before launch and have moved on to the online mode and the PC version. A real offer would have these four features:

It is announced by Rockstar. Check the Rockstar Newswire or the official GTA 6 site, not a screenshot of them.
It is sold in the PlayStation Store, the Microsoft Store or a known retailer. Nobody else can issue a licence.
It never asks for your Rockstar, PlayStation or Xbox password outside the official sign-in page.
It does not ask you to download a file to a PC or phone. GTA 6 runs on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only.

If any one of these fails, close the page.
What is not confirmed

A date or a beta for an online mode. Rockstar has announced neither.
Early access to story expansions or other paid content. No expansion has been announced.
A PC version, and so any PC pre-order or early unlock.
Future GTA+ benefits. The reported list covers launch; Rockstar has not said what members will get if an online mode arrives.
The details of the January 2026 fan story. It rests on reports, not on a statement from Rockstar.

What to do now if you are buying late

Pick your edition on what it contains; see the table at the top. Buying late costs you only the Vintage Vice City Pack.
Buy from the console store, or redeem a boxed code, and start the download at once.
Leave the console in rest mode with internet access so the game and its updates finish overnight.
On PS5, install the latest system software before you launch.
If your purchase came with a month of GTA+, decide now whether you want it to renew.
Check GTA 6 update for the current version number, then start with how to play GTA 6.

The verdict
Rockstar launched the biggest game of the year without selling a head start. Everyone with the same clock got the same game at the same midnight, and the only advantages were a finished download, a time zone or an Xbox region setting. For buyers today that makes the choice simple: nothing was missed apart from a cosmetic pre-order pack. For the future, the rule is equally simple. Until Rockstar announces early access for an online mode, a PC version or new content, there is none, and anyone offering it is not Rockstar.
What we will add to this page

Any officially announced early access, beta or test phase for a GTA 6 online mode.
Pre-order and unlock details for a PC version, if one is announced.
Changes to the GTA+ benefits for GTA 6 that involve early or timed access.
Pre-load and unlock times for major updates or story content, as Rockstar dates them.

Q: Does GTA 6 have early access?
A: No. Neither the Standard Edition nor the Ultimate Edition included early access. Every copy unlocked at midnight local time on November 19, 2026, and the game is now out everywhere on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Q: Does the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition give early access?
A: No. The Ultimate Edition adds 16 extra in-game items for $99.99. It unlocked at the same time as the $79.99 Standard Edition.

Q: Could you pre-load GTA 6?
A: Yes. Pre-loading opened on November 10, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It let you download the game early, not play it early.

# GTA 6 Fast Travel: How RydeMe and Taxis Work

URL: https://gta6box.com/map/gta-6-fast-travel/
Updated: 2026-11-23
Status: confirmed

- GTA 6 fast travel works through rides: order one on the phone, set a destination and pay $100 to skip straight there.
- The RydeMe app is the main method; PowerPyx also describes calling Paradise Taxi from your contacts early in Chapter 1.
- The skip fee is $100 on top of the normal fare, so it is a convenience rather than a free teleport.

GTA 6 fast travel is done by ordering a ride on your phone and paying to skip it: there is no map teleport, but a $100 skip gets you anywhere a car can reach. With a map about twice the size of GTA 5's, you will use it a lot. Here is how each method works, what it costs and when it opens up.
Fast travel at a glance

How to use RydeMe

Press Up on the D-pad to open the phone.
Open the RydeMe app.
Choose where to go. VGC lists three options: your current safehouse, your map marker, or New Destination, which opens the map so you can pick a spot.
Wait for the car. It shows as a white car icon on the minimap, so check there if you cannot see it.
Get in.
Hold L2 (LT on Xbox) to talk to the driver and press Triangle (Y) to pay $100 and skip to the destination. Or do nothing and ride along.

VGC mentions a middle option as well: paying to speed the ride up without skipping it entirely.
How to call a taxi without the app
PowerPyx describes an older-style route that works before RydeMe:

Open the phone and go to Contacts &gt; All Contacts &gt; Paradise Taxi.
Wait for the line to answer and for the taxi to arrive.
Set a marker on the map. PowerPyx says the marker can be placed on parts of the map you have not uncovered yet.
Get in, hold L2 / LT to speak to the driver, and press Triangle / Y to skip for $100.

PowerPyx adds that the same number still works later if RydeMe has no driver available. VGC, for its part, calls RydeMe the only traditional fast travel, so treat the phone call as a fallback.
What it costs

Charge
Amount

Fare
Not listed by any guide; PowerPyx says it rises with distance on RydeMe

Skip
$100, regardless of distance, on top of the fare

Tip: early in Chapter 1, $100 is real money. Once the BuckMe account is open and jobs pay better, it stops mattering. Ideas for getting there: how to make money in GTA 6.
When it unlocks
The two launch guides do not agree:

PowerPyx: taxis by phone from the end of Gone Fishing; the RydeMe app from Chapter 2.
VGC: RydeMe unlocks with Buck Me, because the app needs a bank account.

What both agree on is that you cannot use RydeMe in the first few missions. If the app is missing from your phone, call the taxi number instead.
Limits

The ride is cancelled if the car cannot reach you (VGC). Walk to a road and order again.
No guide describes fast travel during a mission or with a wanted level. Assume you need to be in free roam and clear of the police.
Buses, trams and trains also work as fast travel: board, pick a stop and skip the ride. See GTA 6 train and metro.

Tips

Set a map marker first, then open RydeMe: "map marker" is one tap.
After swapping characters, VGC notes the lead you left may take a RydeMe of their own. See how to switch characters.
Use rides to open up the map early; the full region guide is in GTA 6 map.

New to the game? The other basics are in our beginner's guide.

Q: How do you fast travel in GTA 6?
A: Press Up on the D-pad to open the phone, order a ride with the RydeMe app, set a destination, get in and pay $100 to skip the journey. You can also sit through the ride.

Q: How much does fast travel cost in GTA 6?
A: Skipping a ride costs $100 on top of the fare. PowerPyx says the RydeMe fare itself rises with distance; no guide lists exact fares.

Q: When does fast travel unlock in GTA 6?
A: Guides differ. PowerPyx says you can call Paradise Taxi after Gone Fishing and that RydeMe arrives in Chapter 2. VGC says RydeMe unlocks with the Buck Me mission, because it needs a bank account.

# GTA 6 Mapping Project: The Fan-Made Map of Leonida Explained

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/gta-6-mapping-project/
Updated: 2026-11-23
Status: partly

- The GTA 6 mapping project is a fan-made map of Leonida drawn by a community on GTAForums and Discord. It is not an official Rockstar map.
- It was built years before launch by matching trailers and screenshots to each other and to real places in Florida, and it was revised many times.
- Now that the game is out, the in-game map is the authority; the fan map matters mostly as a record of how close careful guesswork can get.

The GTA 6 mapping project is a fan-made map of Leonida, drawn by a volunteer community years before the game came out; it is not an official Rockstar map and never was. Fans pieced it together from trailers, screenshots and real Florida geography, then redrew it again and again as new footage arrived. This page explains who is behind it, how it was built, what it got right and wrong as far as anyone has shown, and which map you should actually use now that GTA 6 is out.
How we checked this: every claim below comes from Rockstar, from the project's own public posts, or from coverage by PC Gamer, GamesRadar+ and other outlets named in the text. Where only one outlet reports something, we say so. We do not use or link leaked material.
The GTA 6 mapping project at a glance

Question
Short answer

What is it?
A community-drawn map of Leonida, the state where GTA 6 is set

Is it official?
No. Rockstar has never published or endorsed it

Where does it live?
A long thread on GTAForums and a dedicated Discord server

Who draws the map?
Volunteers; the widely shared image is credited to a mapper known as DuPz0r

When did it start?
September 2022, according to PC Gamer

What was it built from?
Trailers, official screenshots and real-world Florida references

How was it versioned?
Numbered drafts, such as v0.047 and the later "YANIS V10"

Biggest correction
The "panhandle" region was removed in a version reported in January 2026

What to use today
The in-game map; see our GTA 6 map guide

What the GTA 6 mapping project is
It is a shared drawing. A group of fans set out to work out the shape of GTA 6's world before Rockstar showed it, and to keep one master image up to date as evidence came in. Each release was a numbered draft. Sportskeeda covered version 0.047 as news in its own right, and Gameranx did the same for a later version labelled "YANIS V10", which tells you how closely the wider fan base followed each redraw.
The project produced a flat, top-down map: coastlines, roads, towns and landmarks, with each feature placed where the community's evidence said it belonged. It was never a playable world and it contains no Rockstar assets.
Why it matters: for about four years before launch, this was the closest thing to a map that existed. Most "GTA 6 map" images you saw on social media before November 2026 were this project's work or copies of it. If you want what Rockstar itself confirmed, start with every confirmed region of Leonida.
Who runs it and where it lives
Two places hold the project together.

GTAForums. The work is organised in a thread titled "Mapping Vice City / Map Discussion Thread". A PC Gamer headline described it as a hivemind of speculation, educated guesses and meticulous analysis, with more than 10,500 posts and three years of research behind it. A separate PC Gamer report from June 2025 says the project had been running since September 2022.
Discord. Day-to-day discussion happens on a mapping Discord server, which PC Gamer has cited as a source of the project's news.

The map image itself is credited to a mapper who goes by DuPz0r. The fan account Church of GTA shared an "updated map" from DuPz0r on X in early October 2022 and credited the Discord group for the work, which fits that timeline. Gameranx credits a later version to a GTAForums user called lxr. We only name people whose handles appear in public posts or in published reports.
Tip: many websites now use "GTA 6 mapping project" in their titles. Almost all of them are separate sites writing about the project or running their own interactive maps. The community itself works in the forum thread and the Discord server.
How fans built a map before the game existed
The method is closer to detective work than to drawing. From how Gameranx, GamesRadar+ and PC Gamer describe the process, it comes down to four habits:

Collect every official frame. Each trailer and screenshot is broken into single shots.
Find the same landmark twice. A tower, bridge or stretch of coast seen from two angles lets you estimate where the camera stood and how far apart things are.
Compare with the real Florida. Leonida is Rockstar's version of the state, so real Miami streets and coastlines are a useful first guess for the layout of Vice City.
Argue about it in public. A placement goes on the map only after other members have tried to knock it down.

It does not always work. A PC Gamer headline quotes one mapper saying that ten people searched every street in Street View to pin down a location, and that the effort "took weeks and failed". The same headline calls the whole exercise painstaking, exhausting and heroic. Gameranx adds that some mappers use the corner points of buildings to work out the angles between them.
Why it matters: the method explains both the project's strengths and its limits. Places that appear in many shots, such as the city's beachfront, can be placed with confidence. Places seen once, from one angle, are guesses.
The trailers that moved the map forward
Official footage arrived rarely, and each release reshaped the map.

Official release
Date
What it meant for the mappers

Trailer 1
December 2023
The first real look at Vice City. GamesRadar+ wrote that the community could "finally get to work" on drawing the whole game

Trailer 2 and the official website
May 6, 2025
Named regions and far more scenery. GamesRadar+ reported the community "connecting the dots" a full year before release

An Extended Look
August 2026
Long stretches of in-game footage shortly before launch

Rockstar's website also named the six regions of the state: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park. That gave the mappers official names to attach to areas they had already sketched.
Tip: if you want to see the footage the map was built from, every official video is listed with dates in GTA 6 trailers.
The rule about leaks
The forum thread carries its rule in its title: "NO LEAK FOOTAGE ALLOWED". That matters because a large amount of early development footage of GTA 6 was stolen and posted online in 2022, and a map built on stolen material would have put the forum at risk.
The picture is less tidy across the wider project. PC Gamer wrote in June 2025 that most of the map was based on information from the 2022 leak, such as the setting. Information is not the same thing as footage, but it does mean the map was never built from official trailers alone. We are not in a position to say which parts of any version rest on which evidence.
Why it matters: this is the main reason to treat the fan map as a fan map. Its sources are mixed, and nobody outside the project can audit them. Our own pages use only what Rockstar published or what two independent guides agree on; the official timeline is in how long GTA 6 was in development.
The biggest correction: losing the panhandle
The clearest example of the project correcting itself is the panhandle. Drafts had included one from the beginning: a north-western arm of land, as real Florida has. In June 2025 PC Gamer reported that people on the mapping Discord expected it to go, with one fan bracing for "the giant list of cuts". On January 6, 2026, Gameranx reported that the newest version of the map had removed it. The reason given was simple: the mappers had found too little evidence for the region and had been guessing, and they said they would draw it back in if later material showed it.
Why it matters: a whole region disappearing from a map that many people had treated as settled shows how provisional every version was. If you saved a copy of the fan map before 2026, it shows land that the project itself later decided it could not support.
How big the fan map said Leonida was
Size was the number everyone wanted, and plenty of sites quoted figures measured from the project's drafts. These were measurements of a drawing, not of the game, and they changed with each version.
Rockstar's own statement is simpler: its developers say Leonida is about twice the size of the GTA 5 map. Rockstar has not published an area in square miles or kilometres.
Tip: ignore any exact area figure that cites the mapping project. Our GTA 6 map size page lists only what Rockstar has said and explains why the square-mile numbers online disagree.
The playable version that Take-Two removed
The fan map inspired other projects. The best known was a mod by a creator known as Dark Space that rebuilt a version of the layout inside GTA 5, so players could drive around an approximation of the new state. He said it was based on a community mapping project, along with leaks and trailer shots. In March 2025 PC Gamer reported that Take-Two, Rockstar's parent company, had made copyright claims against his YouTube videos of the mod, and that he then took the download links down himself. The article quotes his guess that the map "was probably a little too accurate".
That mod was a separate piece of work from the mapping project. The flat community map stayed online.
Why it matters: it shows where Take-Two acted. A drawing discussed on a forum was left alone; videos of a playable recreation were not. Anyone waiting for mods of the real game should read GTA 6 on PC, since there is no PC version yet.

Tip: for finding things, the fan map is the wrong tool. Use the in-game map for navigation and a post-launch guide for item hunting; our GTA 6 collectibles hub lists every collectible type and its total.
What is not confirmed

How accurate the final draft was. We have not found a full comparison between the project's last pre-launch version and the released map from an outlet we would rely on. Pre-launch reports that called it close were judging it against other unofficial material, not against the game.
What the project is doing now. We have not seen a statement from the mappers about their plans since launch day.
An exact start date. PC Gamer gives September 2022, and a public update exists from early October 2022, but we cannot give a first day.
Member numbers. Figures quoted around the web are not sourced to the project.
Rockstar's view. Rockstar has not commented on the project in public.

How to use the maps today
If you are playing now, this is the practical order.

Open the in-game map first. It is the only complete, correct map of Leonida. Areas fill in as you explore.
Learn the six regions. Our region guide explains what each one is and where it sits.
Set up fast travel early. The RydeMe app saves a lot of driving across a state this size; see GTA 6 fast travel.
Use post-launch guides for hunting. Collectibles, animals and easter eggs need positions checked in the released game, not on a pre-launch drawing.
Treat the fan map as history. Compare an old draft with your own map to see what the community got right. Do not navigate by it.
Stay away from leak downloads. Files offered as "the leaked map" or a "playable GTA 6 map" are not something Rockstar or the forum community distributes.

What this means for you
The GTA 6 mapping project was a remarkable piece of fan work: years of patient, public argument that produced a believable map of a game nobody outside Rockstar had played. It was also wrong in places, by its own admission, and it mixed kinds of evidence that outsiders cannot check.
If you are curious about how fans read trailers, it is worth an evening. If you just want to get from Vice City to Mount Kalaga, use the map in the game and the beginner's guide.
What we will add to this page

A comparison of the project's last pre-launch draft with the released map, once a reputable outlet or the mappers themselves publish one.
Any statement from the project about what it does next, such as documenting interiors or keeping the pre-launch drafts as an archive.
A firm start date and version history, if the project publishes a timeline we can cite.
Links to our own region pages for the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga as they are published.

Q: Is the GTA 6 mapping project official?
A: No. It is a community project run by fans on GTAForums and a Discord server. Rockstar Games has never published, endorsed or commented on it, and the only official map is the one inside the game.

Q: Who makes the GTA 6 mapping project map?
A: A group of volunteers. The map image shared most widely is credited to a mapper known as DuPz0r, and the community account Church of GTA has posted updates from what it calls the GTA VI Mapping Discord.

Q: How accurate is the GTA 6 mapping project?
A: Nobody reputable has published a full side-by-side comparison with the released game yet. Before launch the project corrected itself several times, including removing a whole region in a version reported in January 2026, so treat any old version as an estimate.

# GTA 6 Motorcycles: Every Bike and How to Get One

- GTA 6 motorcycles include sport bikes (Carbon RS, Double-T, Alvino V1), dirt bikes (Sanchez, Manchez, Enduro) and cruisers (Avarus, Zombie Bobber, Nightblade).
- Your first free bike is the Highwayman Sanchez Billy gives you in the Chapter 2 mission Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, and you can register it with Moses to keep it.
- After the story, cheats spawn the Maibatsu Sanchez, Nagasaki Carbon RS and Western Zombie Bobber.

GTA 6 motorcycles come in three families: sport bikes for speed, dirt bikes for the swamps and back roads, and cruisers for style. This page lists every motorcycle that at least two launch guides name, then explains how to get one in story mode, which bikes the cheats spawn and how to keep a bike. Sport bikes
The Nagasaki Carbon RS, Dinka Double-T, and Principe Alvino V1 are the fast road bikes. The Alvino V1 is the one new name; the others return from earlier games.
Tip: sport bikes are the quickest way through Vice City traffic, but one crash throws you off. Use them for errands and races, not for missions with a lot of shooting.
Dirt bikes
The Maibatsu Sanchez and Maibatsu Manchez are the dirt bikes you meet first. In the optional Chapter 2 mission Thrillbillies, you rent one at Roostere's Rentals for the Mud Club race. Both PowerPyx and GTABase say the Sanchez costs more but is faster, and a better finish pays back the difference.
The Dinka Enduro is one of the seven vehicles Rockstar names in its edition descriptions; see GTA 6 cars for the full set.
Why it matters: Leonida has huge stretches of mud, trails and swamp around Grassrivers and Mount Kalaga, and a dirt bike is the fastest land vehicle there.
Scooters and cruisers
The Pegassi Faggio is the city scooter. Cruisers include the LCC Avarus and the Western Nightblade; Moses asks for a Nightblade in his optional Steal Vehicles for Moses jobs, so you can get paid to find one. The Western Zombie Bobber is a cheat spawn.
Your first free motorcycle
In Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Billy's second Chapter 2 job, he turns up with a Highwayman Sanchez for the armored truck robbery. Guides suggest parking it in a garage, such as the one in Port Gellhorn, and registering it at Moses' shop so it does not disappear. Read the Moses walkthrough first if registration is not unlocked yet.
Motorcycle cheats
Three bikes can be spawned after you finish the story and unlock their cheats. The codes and the full list are on GTA 6 cheats.

Nagasaki Carbon RS
Complete all exploration challenges

Western Zombie Bobber
Complete all criminal challenges

The challenge list is in GTA 6 challenges.
How to keep a motorcycle
Bikes follow the same rules as cars:

Steal or win the bike.
Take it to Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn (from Chapter 2) or a Pay 'n' Spray later on.
Respray it and choose Register.
Make sure you have a free garage slot.

An unregistered bike vanishes once you leave it, just like a car.

Top speeds. No official numbers exist, so we do not rank the fastest bike yet.
Bicycles. Guides name a few, including the Tuff BMX cheat spawn, but no agreed full list.
Where each bike spawns in free roam.

Spawn locations for each motorcycle

Q: What motorcycles are in GTA 6?
A: Guides name sport bikes such as the Nagasaki Carbon RS, Dinka Double-T and Principe Alvino V1, dirt bikes such as the Maibatsu Sanchez and Manchez and the Dinka Enduro, the Pegassi Faggio scooter and cruisers such as the LCC Avarus and Western Nightblade.

Q: How do you get a motorcycle in GTA 6?
A: Steal one, rent a dirt bike at Roostere's Rentals during Thrillbillies, keep the Highwayman Sanchez from Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, or spawn a bike with a cheat after the story. Register a bike with Moses to keep it.

Q: What is the fastest motorcycle in GTA 6?
A: Rockstar has not published top speeds, and pre-launch rankings were estimates. We will name the fastest bike only after testing.

# GTA 6 Ocean Beach Walkthrough: Y Hotel Room 701

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-ocean-beach-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-23
Status: confirmed

- Ocean Beach is the first mission of Chapter 4 and starts when you return to the Bayside apartment after The Cartel Heist.
- Jason and Lucia move into Room 701 at the Y Hotel, on the Vice Beach side of the city, arranged by Valentina.
- There is no combat: you tour the suite, open the wardrobe and bring Lucia a glass on the balcony.

This GTA 6 Ocean Beach walkthrough covers the opening mission of Chapter 4, in which Jason and Lucia leave the Bayside apartment and move into a suite at the Y Hotel. It is a short, quiet mission with no enemies. Its job is to introduce your new home, a new contact called Valentina and the hotel's concierge, Santino.

Step-by-step
1. Leave the apartment
After the heist, return to the Bayside apartment whenever you are ready. Jason and Lucia pack up and leave.
2. Drive to the Y Hotel
The hotel is on the Vice Beach side of the city. At the entrance your car is taken for you, so get out and walk inside.
3. Meet Valentina
She is sitting on the right side of the lobby. The suite is part of her money-laundering operation. She introduces Santino, the concierge, and promises a meeting with Abraham Gonzalez, a well-known Vice City lawyer who may be able to help the two of you start again. Follow her to the elevator.
4. Find Room 701
Ride the elevator to the 7th floor. Turn left and walk to the far end of the hallway.
5. Explore the suite
Go in and look around while Lucia opens each room. When she opens the bedroom, interact with the wardrobe. Both guides note that new outfits are available from this chapter on; for how wardrobes work, see how to change clothes in GTA 6.
6. Celebrate on the balcony
Keep following Lucia. When she steps onto the balcony she mentions champagne. Go back inside, take the two glasses from the counter and carry one out to her. That completes the mission.
Where players fail
There is nothing to fail. Neither guide lists fail conditions, choices or missable items in this mission.

Q: What do you get for finishing Ocean Beach?
A: Room 701 at the Y Hotel, which PowerPyx lists as the reward. Both guides also say new outfits become available from this chapter through the wardrobe.

# GTA 6 Planes and Helicopters: Every Aircraft and How to Fly

URL: https://gta6box.com/vehicles/gta-6-planes-helicopters/
Updated: 2026-11-23
Status: partly

- You first fly in Chapter 1: Gone Fishing ends with a seaplane flight, and Down to Earth is the first full seaplane mission.
- Planes include the Mammoth Dodo seaplane, the Lapwing Mallard stunt plane and the Duster biplane; helicopters include the Maverick, SuperVolito and Nagasaki Sea Sparrow.
- Land slowly: hitting the water or runway too hard destroys the plane.

GTA 6 planes and helicopters are part of the story from the first chapter: Jason flies a seaplane home at the end of Gone Fishing, and Brian's drug runs keep him in the air after that. This page lists the aircraft that launch guides agree on, explains when flying unlocks, how to take off and land without wrecking the plane, and which aircraft the cheats spawn. Rockstar has not published an official aircraft list, so the page is marked partly confirmed.

When you first fly

Gone Fishing (Chapter 1). The tutorial mission ends with Jason flying the seaplane back to the marina. See the Gone Fishing walkthrough.
Down to Earth (Chapter 1). Brian's first flying job: Jason and Lucia fly to Bobcat Bay, make drops and land on water. See the Down to Earth walkthrough.
Free roam. After that, you can take planes from airstrips and helicopters from helipads whenever you like.

Why it matters: flying is the fastest way to uncover the map. MetaForge and GamesFuze both recommend a crop duster for clearing the fog region by region, because it does not draw unwanted attention and carries plenty of fuel.
How to fly and land

Build speed on the runway or water, then pull back on the left stick to take off.
Steer with the left stick; use the rudder buttons the game shows to turn the nose without banking.
Raise the landing gear on planes that have it.
To land, line up early, cut the throttle and hold the slow-down button (L2 on PS5) while you descend.
Touch down level. On water, steer with the rudder to the dock.

Tip: VGC warns that hitting the water too hard in Down to Earth destroys the plane and fails the mission. Slow, shallow approaches always work.
Where to find planes and helicopters
PowerPyx, MetaForge and GamesFuze agree on these early spots:

Key Lento, Mariana County: a crop duster on the small airstrip near Jason's house, the earliest plane you can reach
West of the swamps, Mariana County: a backup plane
East of Hamlet: a helicopter on a helipad
Vice City skyscrapers: helicopters on rooftop helipads marked (H) on the map; enter the lobby and take the lift up

Tip: fuel runs out, and an empty plane crashes. Land at the nearest airstrip and swap planes when the gauge turns yellow, and turn on the fuel gauge in the HUD settings before long flights.

These aircraft can be spawned after the story once their cheat is unlocked. Codes are on GTA 6 cheats.

Buying or owning aircraft. Guides do not agree on a hangar or helipad you can buy.
Top speeds for any aircraft.
A full list. Some aircraft seen in trailers have no agreed in-game name yet.

What we will add to this page

Exact airstrip and helipad locations on the GTA 6 map
Whether you can own a plane or helicopter
Tested speeds and handling notes

Q: Can you fly planes in GTA 6?
A: Yes. You fly a seaplane at the end of Gone Fishing in Chapter 1, and Down to Earth is a full seaplane mission. Planes and helicopters then appear at airstrips and helipads across Leonida.

Q: What planes are in GTA 6?
A: Guides name the Mammoth Dodo, Lapwing Mallard, Duster biplane, Mammatus, Nimbus jet, Shamal jet and a blimp. The P-996 LAZER fighter jet is a cheat spawn.

Q: What helicopters are in GTA 6?
A: The Maverick and Police Maverick, the SuperVolito, the Nagasaki Sea Sparrow, which can land on water, and the police Buzzard.

Q: How do you land a plane in GTA 6?
A: Slow down well before you touch down; on PS5 guides recommend holding L2. Come in level and steer with the rudder once you are on the water or runway.

# GTA 6 Safe Codes: Every Known Code and How to Get Yours

URL: https://gta6box.com/cheats/gta-6-safe-codes/
Updated: 2026-11-23
Status: partly

- Story mission safes have fixed codes, such as 7700 for Brian's lockup and 1680, 6815 and 0104 for Yasmani's jewelry jobs.
- Safes in free-roam store and bank robberies are randomised, so no list can give you that code.
- To get a random code, threaten an employee and choose the Safe Code prompt, or look for a written note; a sticky bomb opens any safe but raises your criminal profile.

GTA 6 safe codes come in two kinds: fixed codes for story mission safes and keypads, which this page lists, and random codes for safes you crack in free-roam robberies, which you have to get in the game. Every fixed code below appears in at least two independent guides; each row links to the walkthrough where you use it. After the table you will find how to get a random code, what to do when a code fails and when to use a sticky bomb instead.
Facts here are confirmed by Rockstar or by at least two independent launch guides.
