Tip: type every digit, including leading zeros. 0420 and 0104 do not work as 420 or 104.
Codes that are not confirmed yet
These turn up in one guide, or guides disagree on where they go. Try them, but do not rely on them:

6823, 6969 and 0300 for the three Kolt & Associates hideouts in Port Gellhorn (Brooks Boatworks, La Cascara Motel and Kingpin Bowling). The Click says all three come from one launch-day playthrough, where a wall map upstairs at Brooks Boatworks revealed them. The guides behind our Hit Kingpin Bowling walkthrough open that safe with a sticky bomb instead, so bring one either way.
44017, credited to a trailer safe at Cottonmouth Lake by one guide and to a Key Lento safe by another.
6499 at Avery Pawn in Hit Avery Pawn: PowerPyx got this code but warns it may be randomised. See the Hit Avery Pawn walkthrough.
The Pelican Valley codes (0072, 0212 and the password CLEAVES), listed by one guide so far.

Why most safe codes are random
Safes in store and bank robberies you start in free roam get a new combination each time, guides agree, so robbing the same shop twice can give two codes. That is why no online list can give you the code for a convenience store or a bank. The codes in the table above are fixed because they belong to missions and keypads.
How to get a random safe code

Pick a target. Start with a small, low-security store.
Take control. Walk in with a gun drawn, aim at the cashier and press Circle (B on Xbox) to threaten them.
Ask for the code. Find the safe, usually in a back office, then threaten the nearest employee again and select the Safe Code prompt. It only appears when an employee is close enough.
Or search for it. If nobody is near, look around the office for sticky notes, notebooks or papers with the digits written on them.
Enter it and get out. Use the on-screen keypad, take the cash and valuables and leave through a back exit.

Why it matters: safes hold far more than the till, and the valuables inside, such as jewelry and collectible cards, sell to fences. Where the money goes next is covered in how to make money in GTA 6.
No code? Use a sticky bomb
A sticky bomb from Ammu-Nation blows a safe open without a code. Guides warn that it raises your criminal profile and pulls the police in, so it is the last resort. Where to buy one is in GTA 6 guns.
When a code does not work

Check leading zeros. 0420, 0104 and 0420 start with 0.
Check the place. 0420 opens the lab door in Lab Fees; 7700 is the lockup, not a safe.
It may be randomised. If it is a free-roam robbery safe, get the code from staff or a note instead.

What we will add to this page

New fixed codes as soon as two guides confirm them
Bank vault codes and devices from later chapters
The Pelican Valley codes once a second guide confirms them

Q: What are the safe codes in GTA 6?
A: Fixed codes confirmed by two guides include 0420 and 7700 (Lab Fees), 2404 (First Impressions garage), 2008 (Delights safe in Afternoon Delight), 1680, 6815 and 0104 (Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs).

Q: How do you get safe codes in GTA 6?
A: During a robbery, threaten the nearest employee and select the Safe Code prompt, or search the room for a note with the digits. Mission safes have fixed codes.

Q: Are GTA 6 safe codes random?
A: Codes for safes in free-roam robberies are randomised and can change each time you rob the same place. Mission and keypad codes are the same in every playthrough.

Q: Can you open a safe without the code in GTA 6?
A: Yes. A sticky bomb from Ammu-Nation blows it open, but guides warn it raises your criminal profile and draws police attention.

Escape on the freeway.

Step-by-step
1. Blow the cell towers
After the briefing, get in the black car outside with Lucia and Nicole. Drive downtown to the towers you rigged, park in the marked spot at the side of the road and set off the charges.
2. Take the lobby (Jason)
Drive south to the bank. The clock is now running.

Towers destroyed
Time before police respond

All three
Just under 11 minutes

Fewer
Less; neither guide gives the figures

Walk into the lobby and wait for Karim's signal. Then:

Knock out one of the marked guards.
Threaten each marked customer and employee so they move to the middle of the room. Check the side rooms too.
When Karim calls out someone heading for the door, deal with that person first.

Tip: if a guard pulls a gun, shoot it out of his hand rather than killing him. That keeps your Professional rating.
3. Down to the vault floor (Lucia)
Take the open elevator with Raul and Nicole. On the vault floor, threaten Lex, the security guard, until he walks into the security room. Keep the pressure on until he opens the door for the truck, then knock him out once he moves to the wall.
4. Clear the building and the roof (Jason)
La Polilla Negra security comes out of the elevators and down from the upper floor. Clear them, go to the second floor and ride the elevator to the roof. The guards up there are watching the helicopter, so you get the first shots. Clear the roof, climb the ladder to the upper level and secure the backup terminal.
5. Crack the vault (Lucia)
The steps are the ones you practised in Safe Word, slightly harder:

Drill. Hold both triggers to drill. This time both gauges move, so keep adjusting both.
Cable camera. Left stick moves the cable, right stick turns the view. The route makes a very sharp right turn; follow it to the gold hook at the end.
Hold the door. Hold both triggers and mash X (A on Xbox) while Nicole drills.

Inside, bag the big stacks of bills first. Both guides say they are worth more than the loose cash.
6. Hold off the police
As Jason, hold the second floor against police coming into the lobby and SWAT breaching upstairs. Swap the shotgun for a longer-range weapon. As Lucia, cover the left side. When prompted, regroup with Raul in the middle of the room.
A SWAT truck then reverses into the lobby and a flashbang goes off. Stay in cover until your sight returns, then finish the enemies in the lobby.
7. Smoke out the street
Run to the back of the SWAT truck. Lucia climbs in and hands Jason a smoke grenade launcher. Go outside and fire smoke at the police cars in front of the bank. As Lucia, run out of the front door to the bus.
8. Get Nicole out (Jason)

Shoot the enemies rushing the front, then help Nicole up.
Follow her through the door the enemies came from.
Turn right straight away and take the stairs down. Expect a flashbang on the landing.
Take the door on the left when Nicole points it out. It leads to the delivery bay.
Follow the driveway out and get in the Brigade SWAT vehicle at the top of the ramp. Drive off once Nicole is in.

9. Defend the bus (Lucia)
From the back of the bus, shoot the pursuing vehicles and listen to Raul: he calls out cars coming up on either side. After a truck tears the roof off, Raul passes you a grenade launcher with unlimited ammo.
Tip: the helicopter is easiest to hit when it settles directly behind the bus. If you keep missing, switch weapons and use Focus to shoot the pilot.
10. Escape on the freeway (Jason)
In the armored truck, catch up with the bus; you can ram police cars out of the way. Pull up on its left side to jump across. Then drive the bus along the freeway and keep left when Raul says so. A final scene ends the mission and the chapter.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists formal fail conditions. What costs you:

Too few charges. The lobby and vault are on a timer that Hidden Charges sets.
Killing armed guards in the lobby. It costs the Professional rating.
Loose cash first. Take the large stacks before anything else.
Standing up after the flashbang. Wait in cover until you can see.

Optional goals and rewards

GTABase marks the mission as required

After the heist you can stay in free roam or start Ocean Beach, the first mission of Chapter 4. The setup chain is in GTA 6 heists, the bank visit in Sinfrontera National Bank, and trophies in the trophy guide. Full order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: How much does The Cartel Heist pay in GTA 6?
A: $120,000, according to both PowerPyx and GTABase. Neither guide breaks the figure down, and both say to bag the large stacks of bills first because they are worth the most.

Q: How do you start the GTA 6 The Cartel Heist walkthrough?
A: Finish Hidden Charges and every other Chapter 3 main mission. Raul then calls the crew to the planning room in Stockyard.

Q: How do you open the vault in The Cartel Heist?
A: With the three steps from Safe Word: drill while balancing both gauges, guide the cable camera around a sharp right turn to the gold hook, then hold the door steady while Nicole drills.

Q: How do you keep the Professional rating in the bank lobby?
A: If a guard draws a gun, shoot it out of his hand instead of killing him. Both guides give the same tip.

# GTA 6 The Missing Link Walkthrough: Get Monty's Pistol

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-the-missing-link-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-23
Status: confirmed

- The Missing Link is a Cartel Heist prep mission in Chapter 3; Lucia must start it alone at Sloppy Molly's in Watson Bay.
- Monty's 1992 Pistol, a variant weapon, lies on the floor of the photo room and can only be picked up during the mission.
- Lowering Monty all the way into the water kills him and loses the Professional bonus.

This GTA 6 The Missing Link walkthrough covers the mission where Lucia and Andrea grab a cartel enforcer called Monty and Raul's crew questions him. It has a fistfight, a shootout, a drive to Vice City and an interrogation with a loader over a pool, plus a variant pistol that is easy to walk past. PowerPyx subtitles it Meet Andrea.
Before you start

Step-by-step
1. Meet Andrea (Lucia)
Switch to Lucia and go to Sloppy Molly's in Watson Bay without Jason. Andrea has arranged a meeting with Monty, a senior enforcer for La Polilla Negra, at a cockfight. Once Lucia has changed clothes, follow Andrea across the street into the warehouse.
2. Get to Monty
Wait inside while Andrea texts her contact. When prompted, join her at the north door, beside the bouncer in the white suit, and follow her to the back. Monty asks you into the back room and wants photos for the cartel's social media. Use the left stick to change pose and R2 (RT on Xbox, per PowerPyx) to take each picture.
3. Knock out Monty
After the photos Monty attacks. It is a melee fight: keep hitting until he is knocked out.
4. Fight your way out
You now shoot a path through the building so Andrea can get Monty out.
Tip: kill the first enemy, then turn around and go back into the photo room. Monty's 1992 Pistol is on the floor. GTABase calls it a variant weapon you can only get this way, and PowerPyx tells you to take it before moving forward.
Work through the building and check doorways and corners. In the large room where the cockfight was held, more enemies arrive in vehicles through the garage on the right.
5. Drive to Vice City
Lucia and Andrea put Monty in a car outside. Get in and drive to the marker in Vice City. Gang members follow, but you can ignore them: both guides say you lose them on the way out of Hamlet. About halfway there the game prompts you to switch to Jason.
6. Interrogate Monty (Jason)

Meet Lucia and Andrea at the front of the building.
Pull Monty out of the trunk.
Walk behind him with your gun out until he reaches the backyard.
Knock him down when Raul tells you to.
Use the loader to swing Monty over the alligator pool, then lower and raise him as Raul asks his questions.

Tip: lower him close to the water, never into it. Fully lowering him kills him, and getting through every question with Monty alive is what earns the Professional bonus.
7. Deal with Monty
When Raul has finished, you choose.

Choice
Result

Set Monty down on land
Mission completes

Drop him into the pool
Mission completes

Neither guide reports a different reward for either option.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists formal fail conditions. What costs you:

Bringing Jason to the start. The mission only begins for Lucia on her own.
Leaving the photo room behind. The pistol cannot be collected later.
Holding the loader down too long. Monty dies and the bonus is gone.

Optional goals and rewards

GTABase marks the mission as required

More variant pistols are listed in GTA 6 weapons. The other half of the practice for the bank job is Safe Word; the whole chain is in GTA 6 heists. Full order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: How do you start The Missing Link in GTA 6?
A: Finish Company Property, then go to Sloppy Molly's in Watson Bay as Lucia, on her own. Both guides say the mission only starts for Lucia.

Q: Where is Monty's 1992 Pistol in the GTA 6 The Missing Link walkthrough?
A: On the floor of the back room where the photos were taken. Kill the first enemy after the fistfight, then go back in for it before you move on.

Q: Should you drop Monty into the pool in GTA 6?
A: It is your choice at the end, and the mission completes either way. Just do not lower him fully into the water during the questions, or he dies early and you lose the Professional bonus.

# GTA 6 Train and Metro: Can You Ride Them?

URL: https://gta6box.com/vehicles/gta-6-train/
Updated: 2026-11-23
Status: partly

- You can ride trains in GTA 6: the Vice City metro, trams and buses all take you as a passenger.
- Pick a stop after you board and hold Triangle (Y on Xbox) to skip the trip; guides say it costs less than a taxi or RydeMe.
- The Chapter 3 mission Crosstown Traffic has Lucia catch the metro to confront a gang member on board.

Yes, you can ride the train in GTA 6: the Vice City metro, trams and buses all carry you as a passenger, and you can skip the journey once you are on board. That is a big change from GTA 5, where the train was mostly scenery. This page explains how public transport works, how to skip a ride, what it costs compared with taxis, and the story mission built around the metro.
Facts here are confirmed by Rockstar or by at least two independent launch guides.
GTA 6 public transport at a glance

Option
Where
Skip the trip?
Cost

Metro (elevated train)
Vice City
Yes
Fare by trip

Trams
Tram stops
Yes
Fare by trip

Buses
Bus stops across Leonida
Yes
Fare by trip

Paradise Taxi
Call from your phone
Yes, $100 extra
Fare + $100 to skip

RydeMe
Phone app, after Buck Me
Yes, $100 extra
Fare + $100 to skip

A working rail and bus network
Before launch, Rockstar's head of development Phil Hooker told Edge magazine that GTA 6 has working buses and rail, and that he had memorised the routes, as Beebom and Insider Gaming both reported. The elevated metro also appears in Rockstar's trailers and screenshots, running above the streets of Vice City.
Why it matters: trains do not get stuck in traffic and you do not need a car, so the metro is a calm way to cross the city after a chase or when your car has been impounded.
How to ride the train or metro

Walk to a station and climb the stairs to the platform.
Board the train when it stops.
Pick the stop you want.
Ride along and watch the city, or skip to your stop. Dot Esports says you hold Triangle on PS5 (Y on Xbox) to skip.

Buses and trams work the same way from their stops. Guides do not yet publish a route map or timetable.
Tip: use the train for trips inside Vice City and a taxi or RydeMe for long trips across Leonida; see GTA 6 fast travel for those.
What it costs
There is a fare that depends on the journey. Dot Esports says public transport is cheaper than a taxi or RydeMe, both of which charge the normal fare plus $100 to skip the ride.
The metro in Crosstown Traffic
In the Chapter 3 mission Crosstown Traffic, Lucia has to catch the metro to confront a gang member on board while Jason chases boats on the river. She misses the first train, so you sprint under the elevated tracks shown on the minimap to the next station, climb the stairs and board the rear car.
What is not confirmed yet

Driving a train. No guide describes a way to take the controls.
Freight trains outside Vice City and whether they can be boarded.
A full station list and route map.

What we will add to this page

Every metro and tram station on the GTA 6 map
Exact fares for common trips
Whether the police can follow you onto a train

Q: Can you ride the train in GTA 6?
A: Yes. Trains, trams and buses work as public transport. Board at a station or stop, choose where to get off and ride along or skip the journey.

Q: Is there a subway or metro in GTA 6?
A: Yes. Vice City has an elevated metro, seen in Rockstar's trailers and screenshots, and Lucia rides it in the Chapter 3 mission Crosstown Traffic.

Q: Can you drive the train in GTA 6?
A: Guides do not describe a way to drive a train. Treat it as public transport you ride as a passenger.

Q: How much does the train cost in GTA 6?
A: There is a fare that depends on the trip. Guides say public transport is cheaper than a taxi or RydeMe, which add a $100 fee to skip the ride.

# GTA 6 Trucks: Pickups, Semis and Heavy Vehicles

URL: https://gta6box.com/vehicles/gta-6-trucks/
Updated: 2026-11-23
Status: partly

- GTA 6 trucks range from pickups (Vapid Ganado, Bravado Bison, Vapid Caracara 4x4) to semi trucks (MTL Packer, JoBuilt Phantom Custom, Hauler).
- Jason's Vapid Ganado pickup is the only vehicle you have in Chapter 1.
- After the story, cheats spawn the MTL Pumper fire truck, the HVY Bulldozer and the Rhino tank.

GTA 6 trucks cover everything from Jason's beaten-up Ganado pickup to 18-wheel semis, tow trucks, armored trucks and, after the story, a tank. Pickups are the everyday vehicle of rural Leonida, and the game leans into them more than any earlier GTA. This page lists the trucks at least two launch guides agree on, where trucks matter in the story and which heavy vehicles the cheats spawn. Rockstar has not published an official list, so the page is marked partly confirmed.

Tip: the Ganado gets a Retro Build version with the Ultimate Edition; see GTA 6 Ultimate Edition.
Semi trucks
Launch guides list three semis: the MTL Packer, a modern cab with a large sleeper; the JoBuilt Phantom Custom, a classic long-nose 1980s rig; and the Hauler, a flat-nosed cab.
Tow trucks and armored trucks

Tow trucks appear in the world and in missions. In Unwanted Attention, the car you are after sits hooked to a tow truck in the Hamlet impound, and you release it with R3.
Armored trucks are robbery targets. In Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, you chase one on dirt bikes; do not shoot it, follow it until it crashes, then blow the rear doors.

Heavy vehicle cheats

Q: What trucks are in GTA 6?
A: Pickups such as the Vapid Ganado, Bravado Bison, Vapid Caracara 4x4, Vapid Sandking XL and Declasse Yosemite 1500; semi trucks such as the MTL Packer, JoBuilt Phantom Custom and Hauler; plus tow trucks, armored trucks and monster trucks.

Q: Can you get a monster truck in GTA 6?
A: Monster trucks appear in launch guides' vehicle lists, but they do not agree on names or where to find one yet.

Q: Is there a tank in GTA 6?
A: Yes. The Hauners Rhino Tank is a cheat spawn that unlocks after completing all survival challenges, once the story is finished.

# GTA 6 Weapon Wheel: Controls, Loadout Limit and Storage

URL: https://gta6box.com/weapons/gta-6-weapon-wheel/
Updated: 2026-11-23
Status: partly

- Hold L1 (PS5) or LB (Xbox) to open the GTA 6 weapon wheel; press R1 or RB to switch between the Weapons and Items tabs.
- You carry two sidearms and two long guns, one melee weapon and explosives; everything else goes in your car's trunk or a weapon locker.
- Healing items sit in the bottom-left corner of the wheel: Square and Triangle on PS5, X and Y on Xbox.

The GTA 6 weapon wheel opens when you hold L1 on PS5 or LB on Xbox, and it now shows only what you are carrying, not your whole arsenal. GTA 6 limits you to two sidearms and two long guns at a time, and the wheel doubles as your gear menu, with a second tab for clothing and quick slots for healing items. This page covers the controls, the loadout limit, where spare guns are stored and how to set up a loadout before a mission.
Facts here are confirmed by Rockstar or by at least two independent launch guides.
Weapon wheel controls

Action
PS5
Xbox

Open the wheel
Hold L1
Hold LB

Highlight a slot
Right stick
Right stick

Equip the highlighted item

Release LB

Switch between Weapons and Items
R1 (while holding L1)
RB (while holding LB)

Use a healing pill
Square
X

Drink
Triangle
Y

Tip: the healing slots work on either tab, so you can heal mid-fight without picking a weapon first.
What the wheel shows
The Weapons tab has the slots for everything you carry: sidearms, long guns, melee, explosives and equipment such as binoculars.
The Items tab holds what you wear: hats, glasses, masks, bags and outfits. Each item is marked on or off. Highlight one to take it off or change its style.
Why it matters: clothes and gear live in the same menu as your guns, so you rarely need to open the phone or a pause menu during a job.
How many guns you can carry

Slot
Limit

Sidearms (pistols, revolvers, sidearm SMGs)
2

Long guns (rifles, shotguns, SMGs, snipers)
2

Melee
1

One long gun is slung on your back while the other is in your hands. Explosives and throwables are carried on top of that. Rockstar experimented with alternatives for years before keeping the wheel, Dexerto reports, but the limit itself is the real change from GTA 5.
Where your other guns go

Your car's trunk. Open the trunk of your vehicle to store guns and swap them into your loadout. Keep your favourites in a registered car, since unregistered cars disappear (see GTA 6 cars).
Ammu-Nation weapon lockers. Some stores have a locker that holds your full collection. Lucia's optional Chapter 2 task Pick Up a Gun lets you take a gun from the green locker at Gellhorn Outfitters instead of buying one.

Tip: before a mission, park your car close to the start and set your loadout from the trunk. Two long guns for range and close quarters, such as an assault rifle and a shotgun, cover most fights. Prices are in GTA 6 guns.
Binoculars and other equipment
Binoculars sit on the wheel like a weapon: open the wheel with L1 or LB and pick them from their slot. The game teaches them in Gone Fishing, where you use them to watch a meeting on the docks.
What is not confirmed yet

Upgrades to carry space. Some guides say bigger bags appear later in the story, but they do not agree on what changes.
PC controls, until the PC version is out.
What happens to your loadout when you are arrested or wasted.

What we will add to this page

PC keyboard controls when the PC version launches
Loadout suggestions for the hardest missions
What you lose on arrest or death, once tested

Q: How do you open the weapon wheel in GTA 6?
A: Hold L1 on PS5 or LB on Xbox, tilt the right stick to a slot and let go to equip it. Press R1 or RB while the wheel is open to switch to the Items tab.

Q: How many weapons can you carry in GTA 6?
A: Two sidearms and two long guns, with one long gun on your back and one in your hands, plus one melee weapon and explosives.

Q: Where do extra guns go in GTA 6?
A: In the trunk of your vehicle or the weapon locker at some Ammu-Nation stores. You swap guns there.

Q: Is there a weapon wheel in GTA 6?
A: Yes. It keeps the radial wheel from earlier games with a new look, but it only shows what you carry, not every gun you own.

- You carry two sidearms and two long guns at once; the rest go in your car's trunk or a weapon locker.
- Leonida has 24 Ammu-Nation gun stores; Expanded stores stock the heavy weapons.

GTA 6 guns are sold at 24 Ammu-Nation stores across Leonida and cost from $550 for a cheap revolver to $12,000 for the launcher. How many guns you can carry
GTA 6 drops the bottomless pockets of GTA 5. Guides agree you carry two sidearms and two long guns, with one long gun on your back and one in your hands, plus one melee weapon and explosives. Guns that do not fit go in your car's trunk, and some Ammu-Nation stores have a weapon locker for the rest. The full controls are in GTA 6 weapon wheel.
All 24 Ammu-Nation gun stores
Every store sells weapons, ammo, body armour and parachutes, and each one has at least one unique weapon variant. Expanded stores carry the most, including the machine gun, sniper rifles and launchers. Store names match on PowerPyx and GTA Wiki; tiers are as PowerPyx lists them.

Q: What guns are in GTA 6?
A: Pistols such as the Girardi ES9 and Klose K17, revolvers such as the Duke Mustang .357, SMGs such as the Vom Feuer VF5, shotguns such as the Moreland 850, assault rifles such as the Duke 556, sniper rifles such as the Fairview FF-50, the ADB M350 machine gun and the Hillinger Boomer launcher.

Q: What is the best gun in GTA 6?
A: For most fights an assault rifle: GameSpot calls the Duke 556 the most consistent and easiest to control. The Fairview FF-50 hits hardest among sniper rifles, and the Hillinger Boomer launcher has the highest damage rating of all.

Q: How many guns can you carry in GTA 6?
A: Two sidearms and two long guns, plus a melee weapon and explosives. Extra guns go in your car's trunk or the weapon locker at some Ammu-Nation stores.

Q: Where do you buy guns in GTA 6?
A: At Ammu-Nation. There are 24 gun stores across Leonida; Expanded stores such as Big Shots, Woodhatch and Phil's Ammu-Nation carry the most weapons.

# GTA 6 Caught Slipping Walkthrough: Catch Both Thieves

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-caught-slipping-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-22
Status: confirmed

- Caught Slipping starts on its own when you try to enter the Bayside apartment after Boobie Time and First Impressions.
- Stop each thief with Focus and a shot to the legs, first as Jason and then as Lucia, and search the bags they drop.
- The mission ends at Big House Storage, where Jason has bought a storage unit. It pays no cash.

This GTA 6 Caught Slipping walkthrough covers a short mission you do not choose to start: Jason and Lucia come home to a burglary and each chases one of the thieves. It takes a few minutes and ends with the pair renting somewhere safer to keep their things.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Caught Slipping (Chapter 3)

Playable characters
Jason, then Lucia

Given by
Nobody; it triggers at the apartment

Starts at
The Bayside apartment, Vice City

Tip: because the mission starts when you approach the apartment door, do anything you planned at home, such as saving, before you finish both required missions. See how to save in GTA 6.
Objectives

Catch the first thief.
Search the thief's bag.
Catch the second thief.
Search the thief's bag.
Go to Big House Storage.
Follow Jason.

GTABase lists four of these; PowerPyx shows the second search and Follow Jason as separate lines.
Step-by-step
1. Chase the first thief (Jason)
The first thief runs through the construction site next to the apartment. Follow on foot. Draw a gun, activate Focus (L3 + R3 on PS5, per PowerPyx) and aim at the legs.
2. Search the bag
Run up to the thief and check the bag.
3. Chase the second thief (Lucia)
The game switches to Lucia. Do the same again: Focus, one shot to the legs.
4. Search the second bag
Search the bag this thief drops. PowerPyx describes what the scene reveals: the burglars were after the previous tenant's belongings, and the hard drive Jason and Lucia are keeping is safe.
5. Drive to Big House Storage
Jason and Lucia meet outside the apartment. Drive south to the Big House Storage building.
6. Follow Jason
Follow Jason inside and take the elevator up to the storage unit he has bought. The mission ends there.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists fail conditions. Two things make the chases harder than they need to be:

Sprinting without drawing a weapon. The thieves are stopped by a leg shot, so get the gun out early.
Aiming without Focus. Both guides use Focus to line up the legs on a moving target.

Optional goals and rewards

The two sites place this mission at different points in their numbering (57 on GTABase, 65 on PowerPyx) because it starts whenever you next go home, not from a marker. If aiming at a running target is giving you trouble, see GTA 6 difficulty settings for the aim-assist options. Full order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: How do you start the GTA 6 Caught Slipping walkthrough mission?
A: Complete Boobie Time and First Impressions. The mission then starts automatically the next time you try to enter the Bayside apartment in Chapter 3.

Q: How do you catch the thieves in Caught Slipping?
A: Draw a gun, use Focus and shoot the thief in the legs. Then run up and search the bag. You do it once as Jason and once as Lucia.

Q: Is there a reward for Caught Slipping?
A: No cash. PowerPyx lists the reward as none; GTABase lists one unlock without naming it.

# GTA 6 Credit Check Walkthrough: Rob Three Fleeca Banks

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-credit-check-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-22
Status: confirmed

- Credit Check is a Chapter 3 mission from Raul: meet his crew in Stockyard, then rob three Fleeca banks as practice.
- The Dye Pack Jammer from Karim's desk lets you steal marked bills from banks and Payday Loans from now on.
- The reward is $6,000; PowerPyx adds that bank jobs and Payday Loans appear on the map as robbery targets.

This GTA 6 Credit Check walkthrough covers the mission that introduces Raul's crew and teaches bank robbery in three steps: a simple branch, a branch with a safe, and a large branch where the alarm goes off. What you learn here is used again in free roam. PowerPyx subtitles it Meet Raul's Crew.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Credit Check (Chapter 3)

Playable characters
Jason and Lucia together

Given by
Raul

Starts at
Near the Vice Vinyl mod shop, Crosstown; use the intercom on the wall

Requirement
Crosstown Traffic

Reward
$6,000 and the Dye Pack Jammer

Raul's crew: Felipe drives, Karim handles tech, Andrea handles comms and disguises.
Objectives

Meet the crew: talk to Andrea, choose masks, talk to Karim, take the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob the Fleeca in Washington Beach.
Rob the second Fleeca, with your partner waiting in the car.
Rob the final, largest Fleeca.
Lose the cops and regroup at the apartment.

PowerPyx lists 25 on-screen lines; GTABase groups them into these five stages.
Step-by-step
1. Meet the crew
After the scene with Raul, go upstairs to Andrea and pick one of the two pairs of masks on the table beside her. Then cross the room to Karim and take the Dye Pack Jammer from the desk. Stick bombs are on the desk next to him; take some if you have room.
Leave the building. Felipe has a car ready outside.
2. Bank one: Washington Beach
Park outside. Karim cuts the alarm. Before you go in, open the inventory and equip the mask.

Threaten the guards first.
Go behind the counter and empty the four marked cash drawers.
Leave and drive off.

Tip: if a guard draws, knock the gun away or shoot his knees. Both guides say that keeps a Professional rating.
3. Bank two: your partner waits
Karim marks the next branch. Drive around the police search area left by the first robbery. Here the game teaches you to tell your partner to wait in the car.

Go in alone, mask on.
Open the back door with the Snap Gun, or force it; the alarm is off.
Threaten the teller for the safe code and take the cash from the drawer.
Plant an explosive on the inner door, step aside and set it off.
Open the small safe with the teller's code, or with another charge.
Run back to the car.

4. Bank three: the big one
The largest branch is further south. Park facing the road so you can leave in a straight line, and put the mask back on. If one character's bag is full, switch to the other.
There are more guards here and they draw sooner. Threaten them quickly, then take the marked bills from all four drawers.
5. Escape and regroup
The alarm sounds and security opens fire from the back. Fight your way out. Do not go for the safe.
Outside, use the split-up command so your partner leaves separately and the police are divided. Lose them, then head for the Bayside apartment. After a short scene, answer the door to finish.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists formal fail conditions. These are the costly mistakes:

Walking in without the mask. Re-equip it at every bank; it can come off between robberies.
Driving through the first bank's search area. Go around it on the way to bank two.
Trying the safe in bank three. The alarm is already on and the police are coming.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Payment
$6,000

Item
Dye Pack Jammer: marked bills can now be stolen from banks and Payday Loans

Map
Bank Jobs, Big Bank Jobs and Payday Loans marked as robbery targets with green icons (PowerPyx only)

100%
GTABase marks the mission as required

This is the point where robbery becomes a steady income; see how to make money in GTA 6. The crew's real target comes next in Sinfrontera National Bank, the first step of the Cartel Heist covered in GTA 6 heists. Full order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: How do you start the GTA 6 Credit Check walkthrough mission?
A: Finish Crosstown Traffic. Raul calls you to meet the crew: go with both Jason and Lucia to the marker near the Vice Vinyl mod shop in Crosstown and use the intercom on the wall.

Q: What does the Dye Pack Jammer do in GTA 6?
A: It lets you steal marked bills from banks and Payday Loans stores. You pick it up from the desk next to Karim during Credit Check.

Q: Should you open the safe in the third bank in Credit Check?
A: No. The alarm goes off in the third bank and security comes from the back. Both guides say to skip the safe and leave.

Q: What is the reward for Credit Check?
A: $6,000 plus the Dye Pack Jammer. GTABase marks the mission as required for 100% completion.

# GTA 6 Crosstown Traffic Walkthrough: Metro and Boat Chase

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-crosstown-traffic-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-22
Status: confirmed

- Crosstown Traffic is a Chapter 3 mission from Raul that switches between Jason on the river and Lucia on the metro.
- Start it as Lucia at the Courtyard Bar in Stockyard or as Jason at the boatyard in La Perle; either works for both.
- The boat defence has unlimited ammo; shooting the helicopter pilot ends that threat at once. Reward: $3,000.

This GTA 6 Crosstown Traffic walkthrough covers Raul's river job: Lucia leans on a gang member aboard the metro while Jason chases a convoy of boats and takes the one carrying the shipment. The game switches between the two several times, so each part is short.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Crosstown Traffic (Chapter 3)

Playable characters
Jason and Lucia

Given by
Raul

Starts at
Lucia: Courtyard Bar, Stockyard. Jason: the boatyard in La Perle (meet Karim)

Requirement
Car Service, then Raul's call

Reward
$3,000

The target is a Guardia Brothers shipment moving on the Vice River.
Objectives

Follow the boats.
Get to the next station and board the metro.
Confront the Guardia Brother.
Hijack the boat.
Push the emergency stop button.
Defend the boat.

PowerPyx lists reaching the station and boarding as two separate goals; GTABase combines them as Catch the Metro.
Step-by-step
1. Follow the boats (Jason)
After the opening scene Jason is on a bike. Keep to the dirt paths along the river bank and stay with the boats.
2. Catch the metro (Lucia)
At the drop-off the game switches to Lucia, who misses her train. Sprint under the elevated tracks, which are shown on the minimap, to the stairs of the next station. Board the rear car.
3. Confront the Guardia Brother (Lucia)
Walk to the front of the car and intimidate the gang member. Once Lucia has him on the floor, pressure him, then take out his phone and make him place the call. That call is what hands Jason the boats.
4. Hijack the boat (Jason)
Back with Jason, the plan has been noticed and gang members open fire. Kill the two on the dock, get back on the bike and follow the dirt path. Karim tells you to turn right at the bridge. A jump then throws you onto one of the boats.
Now you are driving a boat and shooting. Clear the crew of the closer boat first, then the gunner on the boat with the shipment, and jump across when you are alongside.
5. Stop the train (Lucia)
More gang members attack Lucia in the carriage. Beat them in a fist fight, then go to the back of the train and press the emergency Stop button before the next station. Lucia jumps down to the boat.
6. Defend the boat (Lucia)
Jason drives. Open the rear seats to take an assault rifle and body armor; ammo is unlimited here.

Seasharks and boats come from behind. Aim at the drivers: the vehicle crashes when the driver goes down.
The Coast Guard follows. Deal with its boats the same way.
The helicopter. Shoot the pilot through the front window and it crashes straight away.

Tip: take the armor before you start shooting. You do not have to destroy everything: after a while Karim drops containers from a bridge to block everyone behind you, and the mission ends.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists formal fail conditions. Watch for these:

Losing the boats on the bike. Stay on the dirt paths; do not cut inland.
Running along the street to the station. The route is under the tracks.
Missing the Stop button. It has to be pressed before the train reaches the next station.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Payment
$3,000

Gear
Assault rifle and body armor in the boat's rear seats

100%
GTABase marks the mission as required

Crosstown Traffic unlocks Credit Check and Steal the Zorrusso for Randy. The switching here is scripted; for the free-roam version see how to switch characters in GTA 6. Full order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: Where do you start the GTA 6 Crosstown Traffic walkthrough mission?
A: As Lucia, at the Courtyard Bar in Stockyard to meet Raul. As Jason, at the boatyard in La Perle to meet Karim. Starting from either point starts the mission for both.

Q: How do you catch the metro in Crosstown Traffic?
A: Lucia misses the first train. Sprint under the elevated tracks shown on the minimap to the next station, climb the stairs and board the rear car.

Q: How do you take down the helicopter in Crosstown Traffic?
A: Shoot the pilot through the front window. Both guides say the helicopter crashes immediately.

Q: What is the reward for Crosstown Traffic?
A: $3,000. GTABase marks it as required for 100% completion.

# GTA 6 Easter Eggs: 17 Secrets Found So Far and Where They Are

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/gta-6-easter-eggs/
Updated: 2026-11-22
Status: partly

- Players found at least 17 easter eggs in the first three days; none is confirmed by Rockstar, so each one here appears in two independent lists.
- The UFO abduction near the Starlet Motel east of Port Gellhorn is the only one tied to a trophy, The Truth Is Out There.
- Several eggs point back to GTA 5 and Red Dead, including a yacht whose navigation screen shows Los Santos.

GTA 6 easter eggs range from a UFO that abducts you outside a motel to an actual Easter egg in a bird's nest above Vice City, and players have found at least 17 of them since launch on November 19. Rockstar has confirmed none of them, which is how easter eggs work. This page lists the ones that appear in at least two independent lists, with where they are, how to trigger them and what they refer to, then the rumours we have left out and a route for seeing the best ones in one evening.
How we checked: every egg below is described by at least two of three lists published since launch (BuzzFeed, GTAside and GameRiv). Where a location or trigger comes from only one of them, we name it. Mild spoilers for side content; none for the story.
GTA 6 easter eggs at a glance

1. The UFO abduction
All three lists describe it, and two agree on the place: Kelly County, on a rural road east of Port Gellhorn, near the Starlet Motel. It happens at night, after Chapter 1. A car sits abandoned at the roadside with its lights on. A trail leads from it into the woods and ends at a glow among the trees and a close encounter.
GTAside adds detail we have not seen elsewhere: around 2 AM in-game, a woman held in a beam of light asks you to fetch her car, and after the abduction you wake up three in-game days later. Both it and GameRiv name the reward, the trophy The Truth Is Out There.
Tip: if the car is not there, GTAside says to come back on another night. This is the one easter egg that counts toward the platinum; see the GTA 6 trophy guide.
2. The alien rescue
BuzzFeed and GTAside both say the abduction has a sequel later in the game: you free a live alien from an Area 51-style site. Only GTAside explains how. It describes a dream sequence aboard the ship with a puzzle that points to a restricted site in the south of Leonida, and a permanent boost to health, stamina and Focus as the reward.
Why it matters: if the reward is real, this is the most useful secret in the game. It rests on one detailed source, so we mark the steps as unconfirmed.
3. The Skunk Ape
GTA 6's Bigfoot is the Skunk Ape of Florida folklore. All three lists place it in the southern wetlands around Gullet Marsh and Gambit Bay, and all describe the same odd follow-up: you lose the creature, find a figure made of sticks and rope, examine it and black out.
GameRiv and GTAside both mention a side mission about it involving a character called Kirk. GTAside says it starts from flyers and only at night.
Tip: we cover the sighting spots and the Kirk questline in GTA 6 Bigfoot. The claim that you can hunt the creature and be transformed afterwards comes from social media posts and is listed below as unconfirmed.
4. The giant crab in Gullet Marsh
Two lists put a giant mutant crab in Gullet Marsh; all three link it to the "giant enemy crab" joke from a 2006 games show. It attacks you inside a building.
GTAside gives the trigger: at an isolated outpost in the marsh, switch on the power at the breaker box outside, read the journal on the computer, and step away from the screen.
Tip: bring a strong weapon and body armor before you touch the breaker box. For the wildlife that is meant to be there, see GTA 6 animals.
5. The conspiracy house in Belville
In 2021, the remastered GTA San Andreas showed a photo of a house that fans took as a first look at GTA 6. All three lists say that house is in the game, in Belville, and that its garage is the hideout of a conspiracy theorist who believes the world is a simulation.
GTAside quotes more of the notes: he cannot buy a plane ticket to Los Santos or drive past the state line, and "J and L" do not follow the same rules as everyone else.
Why it matters: it is Rockstar answering five years of fan theories with a joke about the edge of the map. Find Belville on the GTA 6 map.
6. The serial killer's apartment
On Washington Island in Vice City stands an apartment building modelled on the home of the forensic analyst from the TV series Dexter. Two lists describe a kit on the roof (a knife, syringes and rope in a toolbox), and two describe a boat at the nearby dock that looks like the one from the show.
GTAside says the apartment itself cannot be entered and that the spot is reachable as soon as the map opens up.
Tip: this is one of the easiest to see early, because it needs no mission and no time of day.
7. The movie car
BuzzFeed and GTAside both describe a green tuner car hidden in a garage, a close copy of the hero's car from the first The Fast and the Furious film. You can break in and drive it away. GTAside places the garage at a villa on Vespucci Island.
Why it matters: it is a free, distinctive car with no mission attached. For cars with stats behind them, see GTA 6 cars.
8. The literal Easter egg
Two lists agree on this one almost word for word. At the top of a very tall tower in Vice City, after about seven minutes of ladders, there is a bird's nest with coloured eggs in it. Take one and throw it off the edge, and a short hidden scene plays.
GTAside connects it to GTA Vice City (2002), which hid a chocolate egg in a secret room.
Tip: save before you climb. A fall near the top costs you the whole climb; see how to save in GTA 6.
9. The talking parrot
A parrot says the word "generator", and checking a generator nearby turns up a hidden stash of cash. BuzzFeed and GTAside both report it and both link it to Tony, the parrot from GTA San Andreas. GTAside locates it at a liquor store in the Leonida Keys, after a brawl you have to win.
Why it matters: it is one of the few eggs that pays. For reliable income, use how to make money in GTA 6.
10. Cool Dog
Swim or drift too far from shore and a dog in goggles arrives on a jet ski to bring you back. Both BuzzFeed and GTAside describe it. GTAside adds that if you stay on, he takes you to a sandy island full of dogs and digs up some cash; it attributes that part to players.
Tip: GTAside suggests Gambit Bay, off Jason's side of the Keys, as a place to try it.
11. The pentagram in Capri
Two lists describe an abandoned building in Capri with a pentagram on the floor. Knock out a passer-by, lay them on it, and a supernatural sequence starts. BuzzFeed labels it "reportedly"; GTAside describes it in detail, placing the building north of Capri near Tortoise Lake.
Tip: GTAside advises going at night and saving first. Knocking out a bystander is still an assault, so it may count against your criminal profile.
12. The red mutant farmer
GameRiv and BuzzFeed both describe a side mission in which a farmer's chemical experiments turn him into a huge red-skinned brute, a parody of a comic-book hulk. GameRiv says he is trying to grow giant strawberries. GTAside files the same character under unconfirmed leads, so we rate this one a notch lower than the rest.
Why it matters: it shows how strange the side content gets. More of it is in GTA 6 Strangers and Freaks.
13–17. Five nods to GTA 5 and Red Dead
These are small, and each appears in both BuzzFeed's and GTAside's lists:

#
Nod
Where
Refers to

Tip: the ringtone is the quickest of all to check: open the phone settings.
One more carried over from the first trailer: a "Petty Forever" sticker on the door of a liquor store, a tribute to a Florida-born rock musician. Beebom spotted it in the trailer and BuzzFeed reports it in the game.
What is not confirmed
We left these out of the list because they rest on one source, on social media, or on footage nobody has explained:

A giant kraken on the seabed. GameRiv itself calls it unconfirmed.
An unkillable man who reacts when you aim a sniper rifle at him. Two lists mention it; both say it may be a bug.
Turning into a frog after hunting the Skunk Ape. Sourced to posts on X.
A fixed keypad code for the alien rescue site. GTAside lists it as a lead, and its own description says the code comes from the puzzle.
A Love Fist sticker at the Starlet Motel. Reported on one list, a lead on another.
The Monument of Leonidan Supremacy in Manifest Canyon and its possible Morse code. One list, one player's report, unsolved.
A snake in the trunk of the movie car.
A link between the crab and a research facility in Pelican Valley.
Magazine, comic and licence-plate references that appear on a single list without a location.

An easter egg route: what to do first
A sensible order if you want to see the best of them without crossing the map five times:

Any time, anywhere: check the Wind Chimes ringtone in the phone settings.
In the Keys, early: look at the yacht near Jason's house.
Once you reach Vice City in Chapter 3: visit the apartment on Washington Island, then climb the tower for the literal Easter egg. Save first.
At night, after Chapter 1: drive to the Starlet Motel east of Port Gellhorn for the UFO. Fast travel gets you close.
With armor and a good weapon: go to Gullet Marsh for the crab, and look for the Skunk Ape in the same swamps.
Last: the pentagram in Capri, since it means knocking out a bystander.

What this means for you
GTA 6's secrets fall into three kinds. A few are full encounters with their own scenes: the UFO, the crab, the Skunk Ape and the pentagram. A few are places to visit: the Belville house, the apartment and the tower. The rest are small references you notice in passing. Only one affects completion, the UFO trophy, so there is no pressure to chase the others. If you do, treat locations from a single source as leads, not directions.
What we will add to this page

Exact map positions for each egg once a second source confirms them.
The alien rescue steps and its reward, when another guide walks through it.
The Monument of Leonidan Supremacy, if anyone solves it.
New finds: players have had the game for three days, and GTA 5's mysteries took years.
Any easter eggs tied to collectibles or to the 100% checklist.

Q: What are the best GTA 6 easter eggs?
A: The UFO abduction near the Starlet Motel, the giant crab in Gullet Marsh, the Skunk Ape in the southern swamps, the conspiracy house in Belville and the literal Easter egg at the top of a tower in Vice City.

Q: Where is the UFO in GTA 6?
A: In Kelly County, on a rural road east of Port Gellhorn near the Starlet Motel. Go at night once the story is past Chapter 1 and look for an abandoned car with its lights on.

Q: Are there GTA 5 easter eggs in GTA 6?
A: Yes. Two lists describe a yacht near Jason's house whose navigation screen shows the Los Santos map, Michael's Wind Chimes ringtone in the phone settings, and bar customers talking about a bunker with jetpacks under a mountain.

Q: Do GTA 6 easter eggs give rewards?
A: Mostly not. The UFO abduction awards the trophy The Truth Is Out There. Guides also report a hidden cash stash from the talking parrot and a stat boost from the alien rescue, each with details from a single source.

# GTA 6 Ending Explained: How Many Endings and What Decides Yours

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/gta-6-ending/
Updated: 2026-11-22
Status: partly

- GTA 6 has several endings: GTABase and Detonated count five, Beebom counts four, and Rockstar has not published a list.
- The last mission, The End of the Road, ends with a choice between Swim for It and No Surrender; what follows depends on your save.
- Three things decide the outcome: criminal profile, relationship level and the money in Family Savings. Guides disagree on the exact amounts.

The GTA 6 ending is not a single scene: the game has at least four endings, and the one you see depends on a last choice plus three things you have been building all game, namely your criminal profile, your relationship level and your Family Savings. This page explains how the ending is decided, what the guides agree on, where they contradict each other, and what to do before the final chapter if you want the best outcome. It contains light spoilers: we describe who lives, dies or goes to prison, but not the story reasons.
How we checked: every fact below appears in at least two of three independent ending guides (GTABase, Beebom and Detonated). Where only one guide says something, or where they disagree, we say so. Rockstar has not published a list of endings.
The GTA 6 ending at a glance

1. GTA 6 has four or five endings, depending on who is counting
GTABase lists five endings and ranks them from worst to best. Detonated also lists five. Beebom lists four and calls them two good and two bad. The lists overlap but are not identical: each site has at least one ending the others do not describe.
Beebom also reports a Rockstar comment that the story has "a lot more than two" conclusions and that the studio does not think of them as good or bad. We have not seen the original statement, so treat that as reported.
Why it matters: if you read "five endings" on one site and "four" on another, neither is necessarily wrong. They are grouping variations differently. The three outcomes below are the solid part.
2. The three outcomes every guide agrees on
Stripped of names, all three guides describe the same three results:

Outcome
What happens
How guides label it

Both die
Jason and Lucia drive at the roadblock and are killed
Bad; "Bonnie and Clyde" on all three sites

One escapes, one is jailed
Lucia gets away and Jason goes to prison
Good or bittersweet

Both go free
Jason is released and the family leaves together
Best

GTABase and Beebom describe a fourth result as well: the pair try to give up, it goes wrong, and they are shot. Detonated has a similar ending in the water. That is three sources for a second bad ending, with different details in each.
Tip: if all you want is to avoid the two worst endings, the next two sections are the ones that matter.
3. The final choice: Swim for It or No Surrender
The last mission is The End of the Road. It closes Chapter 5, the shortest of the game's five chapters. GTABase and Beebom both describe a roadblock on a bridge, where the game offers two options:

Choice
Result

No Surrender
The both-die ending. GTABase says this happens whatever your save looks like

Swim for It
One of the other endings, picked by the state of your save

GTABase gives the prompts as Triangle (Y on Xbox) for Swim for It and R2 (RT) for No Surrender. Only one guide lists the buttons, so read the screen before you press anything.
Why it matters: No Surrender is the one option that closes off every better ending. Beebom's wording leaves a little room for survival on that path, but GTABase is flat about it, and no guide describes anyone living through it.
4. Criminal profile: the first thing the game checks
All three guides tie the ending to the criminal profile, the rating the game gives each lead for how violently they behave. GTABase lists its tiers as Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable; Beebom uses the same names for the tiers it mentions.

Clean profile (Professional or Hardened): needed for the best ending, according to GTABase and Beebom.
Psycho or Irredeemable: leads to a bad ending even if you choose Swim for It, according to both.

Detonated agrees that a high profile on either character ends in death. Its description of the best ending says the opposite about profiles, which contradicts the rest of its own page; we read that as an error.
Tip: our walkthroughs flag the moments that move the profile. Shooting tires and legs instead of drivers in First Impressions, or steering the safe away from cyclists in Safe Word, are typical. Small choices like these add up over a very long story; see how long GTA 6 is.
5. Relationship level: keep it at the top
GTABase requires the top relationship level, Hot Together, for both of its good endings. Beebom says the relationship must be maxed for the best one. Detonated asks for a high relationship rating.
The relationship meter rises with everyday things, such as time together, answering messages and pulling off jobs as a pair, and falls with neglect. How it works is covered in GTA 6 romance.
Why it matters: this is the requirement you cannot fix with money or a single replay of the last mission. It is built over the whole story.
6. Family Savings: $2 million or $3 million
Family Savings is the shared account you open in Buck Me early in Chapter 1. All three guides say a large balance there is needed for the best ending:

Guide
Amount for the best ending

GTABase
$2,000,000

Detonated
$2,000,000

Beebom
At least $3,000,000

Two guides against one favours $2,000,000, and GTABase and Beebom both mention a payment of $2.5 million in the best ending itself. GTABase adds that with a clean profile and top relationship but less than $2,000,000, you get the ending where one lead goes to prison.
Tip: if you can, bank $3,000,000 before Chapter 5. That satisfies every guide. Robberies become a steady earner from Credit Check onward; more methods are in how to make money in GTA 6.
7. Which ending is the "good" one?
GTABase and Beebom both name the same best ending: Lucia escapes, Jason is arrested, and she later gets him out, so the family ends up together. Beebom and Detonated both say they move to Liberty City. Detonated does not rank its endings.
The middle ending, in which Lucia raises their son while Jason is in prison, is called good by GTABase and bittersweet by Beebom.
Why it matters: nothing here is "canon" in any official sense. Rockstar has not named a true ending.
8. What happens after the credits
GTABase and Beebom agree on what opens up once the story is over:

Free roam continues, with unfinished side missions, robberies and collectibles still available.
The Cheats section appears with 61 cheats. Some work at once and the rest need their own unlock tasks; see GTA 6 cheats.
A 100% checklist appears under Stats in the Progress menu; see GTA 6 100% completion.

All three guides mention a short scene after the credits involving Cal, Jason's friend from the Keys. They describe it differently, so we will leave the details to the game.
9. You can replay the finale, with limits
GTA 6 has no mission replay; that is covered in can you replay missions in GTA 6. The ending is the reported exception. GTABase and Beebom both say that after the credits you are put back just before The End of the Road and can play it again with a different choice.
They differ on how much you can change. GTABase says you can top up your savings and relationship before trying again. Beebom says changing the profile or relationship needs an older save.
Tip: do not rely on either. Make a manual save in its own slot at the start of Chapter 5; how to save in GTA 6 explains the slots.
What is not confirmed

The exact number of endings. Four or five, with no official list.
A deal ending before the final mission. GTABase alone describes an early bad ending triggered by accepting an offer at the end of Protective Custody, the mission before the finale. No other guide mentions it.
An ending where Jason escapes and Lucia is jailed. Only Detonated lists it.
A "save the cop" requirement for the best ending. Only Detonated mentions it, without saying where it happens.
The savings threshold. $2,000,000 on two sites, $3,000,000 on one.
Whether No Surrender can ever be survived. GTABase says no; Beebom's wording is looser.
Trophies tied to the ending. GTABase names two hidden trophies for the final mission and its choices. We will add them to the trophy guide when a second list matches.

How to set up the best ending: a checklist
Do these before you start Chapter 5. GTABase says the finale begins with a point-of-no-return warning.

Save in a separate slot before the last chapter.
Check both criminal profiles. Aim for Professional or Hardened on Jason and on Lucia.
Raise the relationship to its top level, Hot Together.
Put $3,000,000 in Family Savings if you can, and at least $2,000,000 if not. The guides count the balance of that account, so deposit your cash.
At the bridge, choose Swim for It.
If you get an ending you do not want, reload the Chapter 5 save and fix what was missing.

What this means for you
The ending is a report card on the whole playthrough. One button press at the bridge matters, but only as a veto: No Surrender gives the worst result, and Swim for It hands the decision back to how you played. If you kept the violence down, looked after the relationship and saved money, the game rewards you. If you are close to the finale with a Psycho profile and an empty savings account, expect a bad ending and plan a second run at it from an earlier save.
What we will add to this page

The confirmed number of endings, once the guides settle or Rockstar comments.
The exact savings figure, when a third source breaks the $2 million against $3 million tie.
Whether the deal ending in Protective Custody exists as GTABase describes it.
Walkthroughs for the Chapter 5 missions, added to the mission list.
The ending trophies, with their unlock conditions.

Q: How many endings does GTA 6 have?
A: Guides count four or five. GTABase and Detonated list five, Beebom lists four, and their lists do not match one for one. All three agree on three outcomes: both leads die, one escapes while the other goes to prison, and both go free.

Q: How do you get the best GTA 6 ending?
A: Reach the finale with a clean criminal profile, a maxed relationship and a large balance in Family Savings, then choose Swim for It. GTABase and Detonated say $2,000,000 in savings; Beebom says at least $3,000,000.

Q: Can you replay the GTA 6 ending?
A: GTABase and Beebom both say that after the credits you are placed back before The End of the Road and can play it again. Beebom adds that changing your profile or relationship needs an older save.

Q: What unlocks after the GTA 6 ending?
A: Free roam continues, the Cheats section opens with 61 cheats, and a 100% completion checklist appears under Stats in the Progress menu.

# GTA 6 First Impressions Walkthrough: Code 2404 and the Decoy

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-first-impressions-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-22
Status: confirmed

- First Impressions is a Chapter 3 mission from Raul for both Jason and Lucia; it unlocks after Car Service.
- The garage on Waxman Island opens with the code 2404 on the wall panel.
- Jumping the half-raised bridge to Rialto Islands loses the police; the mission pays $3,000.

This GTA 6 First Impressions walkthrough covers the first job with Raul in person: a getaway from a bank robbery that turns out to be a decoy. It is mostly a chase, with Jason shooting and Lucia driving. PowerPyx subtitles it Meeting with Raul.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
First Impressions (Chapter 3)

Playable characters
Jason and Lucia

Given by
Raul

Starts at
The garage on Waxman Island, Vice Beach; go there with both characters

Requirement

Reward

Stock up on healing items first. Jason takes fire on foot in the middle of the mission.
Objectives
The two guides word the on-screen goals differently. This is the order both describe:

Open the garage and get in the car.
Go to the meetup and pick up Raul.
Hold off the cops.
Drive to Rialto Islands.
Go to the parking lot and switch to the van.
Drive Raul to the drop-off.

Step-by-step
1. Open the garage with 2404
At the Waxman Island garage, use the panel on the wall and enter 2404. The game puts you in control of Lucia. Get in the car.
2. Pick up Raul
Drive to the marked spot on the south side of Ocean Beach. Raul gets in, and the police show up at once: he has just robbed a Fleeca bank.
3. Hold off the cops
You play Jason, shooting from the car while Lucia drives.
Tip: for a Professional or Hardened rating, aim at tires and engines. Shooting drivers also crashes their cars, but doing it often counts as Violent.
The car then crashes. Keep officers away from it; shoot the ones who come close in the legs. Watch Jason's health and heal from the inventory when you need to.
4. Reverse out and drive to Rialto Islands
Control passes to Lucia. Back the car fully onto the street, then head for Rialto Islands, the islands between the two halves of Vice City. Jason and Raul keep shooting; your job is to avoid the police cars in your path.
The bridge ahead is partly raised. Jump it and the police are left behind.
5. Switch vehicles
Drive to the marked parking lot. Get out quickly and take the van parked nearby.
6. Drop off Raul
Drive to the marker in Bayside. Raul explains that the bank job was a decoy for a bigger robbery on the other side of the city, pays you and gets out. That ends the mission.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists formal fail conditions. These are the points where the mission goes wrong in practice:

Low health after the crash. Jason is exposed on foot. Heal before officers close in.
Driving forward out of the crash. Reverse fully onto the street first.
Ramming police cars on the way to Rialto Islands. Steer around them; the bridge jump ends the chase for you.

Optional goals and rewards

$3,000

Rating

100%
GTABase marks the mission as required

Raul's next job is Crosstown Traffic, and First Impressions is also one of the two missions needed for Caught Slipping. For how the chase rules work, see GTA 6 wanted level. Raul's jobs lead to the Cartel Heist; see GTA 6 heists. Full order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: What is the garage code in the GTA 6 First Impressions walkthrough?
A: 2404. Enter it on the wall panel beside the garage on Waxman Island. PowerPyx and GTABase both give the same code.

Q: How do you start First Impressions in GTA 6?
A: Finish Car Service. Raul then asks you to collect a car and meet him; go to the garage on Waxman Island in Vice Beach with both Jason and Lucia.

Q: How do you keep a Professional rating in First Impressions?
A: Shoot tires and engines to stop police cars and shoot officers in the legs. Both guides say shooting drivers pushes the rating toward Violent.

Q: What is the reward for First Impressions?
A: $3,000. GTABase also marks the mission as required for 100% completion.

# GTA 6 Safe Word Walkthrough: Steal the Practice Safe

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-safe-word-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-22
Status: confirmed

- Safe Word is a Cartel Heist prep mission in Chapter 3, given by Nicole at Raul's compound after Company Property.
- The remote that reveals the safe is in the left drawer of the desk in Gil's office at his mansion in Peacock Estates.
- Opening the practice safe gives Gil's Kalinga .50 pistol and $1,500, and teaches the safecracking used in the heist.

This GTA 6 Safe Word walkthrough covers the theft of a practice safe: a smaller model of the one in Sinfrontera National Bank, kept in the mansion of an adult-film producer named Gil. Jason bluffs his way through a film shoot, Lucia tears the safe out with a truck, and the mission ends with a safecracking tutorial worth doing properly. PowerPyx subtitles it Steal the Practice Safe.

Speak to Nicole at the compound, then take the large truck parked outside. Gil's mansion is in Peacock Estates, at the very south edge of the city.
2. Sneak onto the set (Jason)
Crouch and go through the front gate. Move down the right side of the house and through the archway. A woman coming out of a door stops you, so blend in: follow Gil's assistant to the backyard, where a shoot is under way.
3. Play your part

Run around the house to the door you could not get through earlier. Inside, go through the first double doors, then the closed doors on the right side of the hallway. That is Gil's office. Open the drawer on the left side of the desk and use the remote. It reveals the safe.

Drill. Hold the drill in position. Keep the right gauge steady and adjust as the left one rises. Do not let the light on the drill turn red.
Cable. Guide the cable through the door without touching the walls, and hook the gold ring at the end.
Hold the door. Hold both triggers and mash the button to keep the door secure while Nicole drills and enters the combination.

The safe opens. Take Gil's Kalinga .50 and the $1,500 inside, then quit the practice to complete the mission.

# GTA 6 Security Expert Walkthrough: Get Nicole Out Quietly

This GTA 6 Security Expert walkthrough covers a stealth pick-up: Jason and Lucia take the bank's security specialist, Nicole Park, out of a house where the cartel's men are guarding her. Done properly, no shot is fired.

Q: Where is Nicole in the GTA 6 Security Expert walkthrough?
A: In a guarded house in Waning Sands, Leonard County. Inside, cross the hallway to the bedrooms and open the closed door of the room in the north-east corner.

Q: How do you avoid the guards in Security Expert?
A: Follow Jason closely. Wait at the back of the house until the guard comes out of the back door and walks off, then go in. On the way out, stay right behind Jason along the side of the house.

Q: How do you start Security Expert in GTA 6?
A: You do not start it yourself. It begins automatically after Sinfrontera National Bank and moves you to Waning Sands.

# GTA 6 Steal the Zorrusso for Randy Walkthrough: Key Cloner

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-steal-the-zorrusso-for-randy-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-22
Status: confirmed

- Steal the Zorrusso for Randy is a Chapter 3 mission, also titled Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs; it unlocks after Crosstown Traffic.
- The Zorrusso is on the ground level, east side, of the walled garage at Hathaway Apartments in Ocean Beach.
- It pays $21,250 plus $10,000 if the car arrives in good condition, and unlocks the Key Cloner and Randy's Wish List.

This GTA 6 Steal the Zorrusso for Randy walkthrough covers the mission that gives you the Key Cloner, the tool for stealing high-end cars. It is short, pays $21,250 or more, and opens Randy's Wish List. PowerPyx lists it under the title Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs.
Before you start

Detail

Objectives

Get into the garage.
Install the Key Cloner.
Find and steal the Zorrusso.
Drive the Zorrusso to Randy.

Step-by-step
1. Climb into the garage
The parking garage at Hathaway Apartments is walled. Climb the wall. Randy calls as you get in and explains two things: the Key Cloner, and the advanced tracker fitted to this car.
2. Install the Key Cloner
Press Up on the D-pad to open the phone and choose Install key_cloner_v1.6.9; PowerPyx says it is the bottom option. One install covers both Jason and Lucia.
3. Steal the Zorrusso
The car is on the ground level, on the east side. Interact with the door, then interact again to use the Key Cloner. It works like the Slim Jim: when the indicator turns pink, push the stick in the matching direction.
4. Beat the tracker
A red icon above the minimap is the tracker. A bar around it fills when you are not driving fast enough. If it fills, your position is sent to the police.
Tip: the bonus needs a car in good condition, and the tracker punishes slow driving. Pick a route with wide roads before you pull out, so you can keep your speed without scraping traffic.
Near Randy's showroom the icon turns grey: the tracker is off. Drive around the lot to the garage door and go inside.
5. Follow Randy
Randy comments on the state of the car. Good condition earns the extra $10,000; otherwise he mocks your driving. Follow him to the board, where he explains the Wish List.
Randy's Wish List
The Wish List is a set of rare cars Randy pays well for. Their locations start as unknown. You can find them on your own or ask Randy for tips, one at a time. PowerPyx compares it to Moses's car requests in Chapter 2; see the Moses walkthrough.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists a fail condition; the tracker brings police, not a mission failure. What costs you:

Crawling through traffic. The tracker bar fills and the police get your position.
Scraping the car. It costs the $10,000 bonus.
Stopping at the front of the showroom. The delivery point is inside the garage, around the lot.

Q: Where is the car in the GTA 6 Steal the Zorrusso for Randy walkthrough?
A: In the walled parking garage of Hathaway Apartments in Ocean Beach, on the ground level on the east side. Climb the wall to get in.

Q: How does the Key Cloner work in GTA 6?
A: Open the phone and install key_cloner_v1.6.9; it installs for both Jason and Lucia. At the car door, use the cloner and push the stick in the right direction when the indicator turns pink, as with the Slim Jim.

# GTA 6 Top Billing Walkthrough: Find Roxy at the House Party

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-top-billing-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-22
Status: confirmed

- Top Billing is a Chapter 3 mission from Dre'Quan that starts at the Jack of Hearts in Crosstown after Car Service.
- At the house party, let the dog out through the kitchen door to move Jacki away from the door to Roxy.
- Jason cuts the power at the green box on the sidewalk corner. The mission pays no cash.

This GTA 6 Top Billing walkthrough covers the Real Dimez' headline night, which falls apart when the rapper DWNPLY takes over their set. There is no combat beyond one punch. The mission is a short drive, a food stop and a small puzzle at a house party. PowerPyx subtitles it Watch the Real Dimez.
Before you start

PowerPyx splits these into 14 on-screen lines; GTABase groups them into seven. The order is the same.
Step-by-step
1. Go backstage
You are taken into the club automatically. Dre'Quan is backstage, down the hallway to the right of the stairs.
2. Find the Dimez
After the scene you play Lucia. Ask the host at the front door: the Dimez have been thrown out. Bae-Luxe and Roxy are arguing in the parking lot.
3. Follow Roxy
Roxy drives off. Get into the nearby car with the others and follow her until a passing train cuts you off.
4. Stop at Peewees
Dre'Quan suggests getting food. Go into Peewees and order for the group at the counter. When they decide to go after Roxy, return to Bae-Luxe's car.
5. Reach the house party
The party is in the south of the city, near VCIA. Lucia goes in alone through the back door. A woman called Jacki is leaning on the door that leads to Roxy and will not move.
6. Let the dog out
Go to the kitchen on the other side. Jacki's dog is pawing at a door there. Open it so the dog goes out into the yard, and Jacki follows. Use the door she was blocking.
7. Deal with Kaamal
Roxy is talking to a man named Kaamal. When he stands up, hit him. One knockout is enough to persuade Roxy to leave.
8. Cut the power (Jason)
The game switches to Jason outside. Open the green power box on the sidewalk corner, look at its left side and flip the switch. The house goes dark.
9. Follow Roxy
Back as Lucia, follow Roxy out of the house to finish.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists fail conditions, and the mission has no timer either of them mentions. The usual hold-ups:

Trying to talk Jacki out of the way. She only moves for the dog.
Looking for the switch on the front of the power box. It is on the left side.
Expecting the chase to succeed. The train always stops it; the story continues at Peewees.

Q: How do you get past Jacki in the GTA 6 Top Billing walkthrough?
A: Go to the kitchen side of the house, where her dog is scratching at a door. Open that door so the dog runs into the yard, and Jacki leaves her post.

Q: Where is the power box in Top Billing?
A: On the sidewalk corner outside the house. It is green. As Jason, open it, look at its left side and use the switch.

A: No. PowerPyx lists the reward as none, and GTABase lists one unlock without naming it.

A: Finish Car Service. Dre'Quan then invites Jason and Lucia to see the Real Dimez at the Jack of Hearts in Crosstown.

Missable GTA 6 achievements
None of the story trophies can be missed. Two guides flag one trophy as possibly missable:

Positive Mental Attitude. One of the 18 meditation spots is tied to Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether it stays available later. Meditate when the game first offers it in Chapter 1 to be safe.

Everything else can be finished in free roam after the story.
GTA 6 platinum roadmap

Play the story. This gives 12 trophies. Meditate in Chapter 1. Do stranger missions as they appear.
Finish the stranger strands. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a trophy, and 8 strands in total give Strangers & Freaks. Kenton is away for a while after Chapter 1 and comes back later.
Work through the 100% checklist. It shows up after the story. It covers most other trophies on the way, because it asks for more: 300 stunts against 250, 70 challenges against 50, 200 vehicles against 100. See GTA 6 100% completion.
Clean up the one-off trophies. The tank, the airport, the jewelry store, 4-star escape and the hidden ones.

Two trophies need more than the 100% checklist does. Positive Mental Attitude needs all 18 meditation spots, while 100% needs 15. Top Fun needs a win at every drone race location.

Q: Is there a GTA 6 trophy guide for the platinum?
A: Yes. The platinum, Vice Got a Price!, needs the other 54 trophies. Finish the story, then work through the 100% checklist, and clean up the stranger missions and one-off trophies.

Q: How many trophies and achievements does GTA 6 have?
A: 55 on PS5: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze. The Xbox list has the same entries and adds up to 1,000G.

Q: Are any GTA 6 trophies missable?
A: Guides flag one as possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude. One meditation spot is tied to Chapter 1, so meditate there before you move on.

Q: What is the hardest GTA 6 trophy?
A: A Long Road, the gold trophy for 100% completion. It needs far more than any other trophy, for example 300 stunts and 70 challenges.
